Ambedkar Konaseema, Andhra Pradesh: A fishing boat carrying eight fishermen has gone missing after venturing into the sea from Odalarevu in Ambedkar Konaseema district, triggering concern among their families. The boat, owned by Kopanati Ramakrishna Varma of Komaragiri Patnam village in Allavaram mandal, left the jetty at Odalarevu on August 3 through the Vainateya river-sea confluence for fishing. The fishermen had reportedly carried provisions and diesel sufficient for around 15 days and were expected to return by August 13. However, the boat failed to return as scheduled, and there has been no communication from the fishermen. Their mobile phones and the GPS system installed on the boat are also reportedly not functioning. After the boat failed to return even four days after the expected date, the owner’s family informed the Coastal Security Police at Odalarevu and the district authorities. Konaseema District Collector R. Mahesh Kumar sought assistance from the Indian Coast Guard in Visakhapatnam to trace the missing boat and rescue the fishermen. Preliminary information suggests that the boat may have travelled towards the Visakhapatnam–Paradip coastal region for fishing. The Fisheries Department confirmed that eight fishermen, including boat owner-cum-driver Kopanati Ramakrishna Varma, were on board. The Collector directed Fisheries Department officials to immediately coordinate with the Indian Coast Guard for search and rescue operations. He also instructed officials to coordinate with District SP Rahul Meena and collect all available information from the boat owner, family members, and other fishermen, and share it with the Coast Guard and other concerned rescue agencies. The Collector directed officials to continuously monitor the situation and immediately communicate any information regarding the whereabouts and safety of the fishermen to the district administration: Konaseema District Collector R. L’adhésion d’Haïti à la CAF ouvre de nouvelles perspectives de coopération et de financement pour la mise en œuvre de projets structurants et d’initiatives de développement au bénéfice de la population haïtienne. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/MAE_Haiti/status/2089433265224704219#m

Today, our High-Level Inter-American Delegation to #Haiti held productive discussions with Haitian authorities, led by Prime Minister @PrimatureHT Alix Didier Fils-Aimé @citoyendidier, the Minister of Foreign Affairs @MAE_Haiti, members of the Cabinet, and other national authorities, on the path forward for Haiti. A central focus of our discussions was the urgent need to advance preparations for elections. Restoring elected institutions is essential to Haiti’s democratic future and to creating the stability and confidence needed for the country’s recovery. Security and sustainable development are critical to that effort and must advance alongside the electoral process. We reaffirmed the commitment of the @OAS_official to supporting Haitian-led efforts toward credible, inclusive, and peaceful elections, with full respect for Haiti’s sovereignty and leadership. In particular, we discussed the importance of accelerating the preparation of the electoral registry and strengthening civic information campaigns so that the largest possible number of Haitians can exercise their right to participate. The #OAS stands ready to provide technical cooperation throughout the electoral process and, when the time comes, electoral observation. Security remains fundamental to making elections possible. We recognize the efforts underway to strengthen Haiti’s national institutions, particularly the Haitian National Police @pnh_officiel and other national security actors. These efforts include the P4000 program supported by the U.S. @StateDept’s Bureau of International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs @StateINL. The OAS is contributing through complementary initiatives, including Forward Operating Bases, capacity-building for the HNP, and cooperation with the judicial police to strengthen capabilities to trace illicit financial flows. Lasting stability will require sustained international support alongside stronger Haitian capabilities and effective coordination. Our conversations also underscored that Haiti’s democratic recovery must deliver hope and opportunity for its people. The participation of the Inter-American Development Bank @the_IDB, CAF – Development Bank of Latin America and the Caribbean @AgendaCAF, and the World Bank @WorldBank allowed us to explore initiatives supporting Haiti’s longer-term development. Education, healthcare, job creation, and economic opportunity cannot wait. They are priorities now. We also discussed strengthening coordination among international partners, development banks, the private sector, and regional organizations to better align our collective support with Haiti’s priorities. The objective that brings these efforts together is clear: helping create the security, institutional, and social conditions that allow Haitians to choose their representatives through credible elections and move toward a more democratic, stable, and prosperous future. The Inter-American community stands in solidarity with the Haitian people and remains committed to accompanying Haiti on that path. #OASwithHaiti

I'm, again, not particularly concerned by reports about the US Navy having been asked to move the island on the future carriers for "aesthetic reasons". I'm not saying I don't believe Trump can have said something about that; he absolutely might have. But I feel pretty confident in assuring you that the Navy is thinking about potentially moving the island again not because of Trump, but because of plenty of good or potentially good reasons. The still image I've attached here is CAPT Tal Manvel (Ret), who was the Program Manager who led the design work for the FORD class carriers as they are today, showing a number of design ideas / iterations that were considered during the process. This is Design 5 and was, he always mentions it, the "ideal" design they had landed upon, in many ways. The FORD as finally settled was in some ways a cut down / revision of Design 5. You see that white rectangle right up front...? That was where the Island was going to be. Tal Manvel and his team originally wanted the island there, but listened to contrarian observations and ultimately moved it aft. They had earlier looked at having the island bang in the literal middle, with two angled decks, one on either side. They also considered a more central positioning of the island, not just down the lenght of the ship, but inward on the deck as well, to have a super "alaska highway" outboard of the island enabling aircraft movement well clear of the runway. CVA-01 style, in concept (not in detail, of course). They also clipped off the stern corners of the flight deck because they listened to LSOs who said, with practical (but questionable) wisdom that if the deck was made full width at the back, sooner or later someone would park aircraft there, and cause trouble during landing ops. They preferred taking the deck extensions off entirely rather than risk that. All options have merits and defects, and there is nothing to say the current position is "the best". It's literally just the compromise that was selected at the time, very good for some things, not so great for others. It is, again, not heresy to say the future carriers might change the island positioning again. I assure you it's one of the many things they'll always look at. And while a President's wish might be added to the list of considerations, i do not think for a moment it will be the one that drives the thinking. My choice remains not to subscribe to the hysteria unless there are good reasons to be worried. At present, I do not feel there are good reasons.

عمران خان کی طبی رپورٹس تشویشناک ہیں۔ میں نے کئی ماہرین سے مل کر ان کا جائزہ لیا ہے، اور یہ سادہ الفاظ میں لکھ رہا ہوں تاکہ ہر پاکستانی سمجھ سکے کہ اصل صورتحال کیا ہے۔ ترتیب کے لحاظ سے جو چیز مجھے سب سے زیادہ پریشان کر رہی ہے وہ ہے ان کی ذہنی دباؤ اور اضطراب کی کیفیت ہے، دل کی دھڑکن میں بے ترتیبی، اور بڑہتا ہوا بلڈ پریشر۔ رپورٹ میں نیند کی کمی کا ذکر نہیں، مگر ادویات دیکھ کر یہ بھی تقریباً یقینی لگتا ہے۔ میں عمران خان کو 35 سال سے زیادہ عرصے سے جانتا ہوں۔ ذہنی دباؤ کبھی ان کی کمزوری نہیں رہا۔ مگر اب یہ عروج پر ہے، خود بتا رہا ہے کہ تین سال کی قید اور مکمل تنہائی نے ان پر کیا اثر ڈالا ہے۔ اس کی وجوہات سمجھنا مشکل نہیں: ملک کی صورتحال، جیل میں مقید ساتھی، شہید ہونے والے اور ان کے سوگوار خاندان۔ خود ان کی اپنی تنہائی، نہ اخبار، نہ کتابیں، باہر کی دنیا سے مکمل بےخبری۔ اور بلاشبہ بشریٰ بی بی، اپنی بہنوں، کارکنوں اور پارٹی کے بارے میں ان کی فکرمندی۔ دوائیوں کو دیکھیں، کیونکہ تشخیص تو موجود ہی نہیں۔ انہیں Citani اور Lexotanil دن میں تین بار دی جا رہی ہیں۔ یہ نیند کی کمی کا علاج نہیں۔ یہ دن کے وقت کے اضطراب کا علاج ہے۔ ان کی دل کی دھڑکن 54 فی منٹ ہے۔ ڈاکٹر اسے "نارمل" کہیں گے۔ لیکن ان کے لیے یہ نارمل نہیں۔ ان کی آرام کی حالت میں دل کی دھڑکن ساری زندگی 40 کی دہائی کے ابتدائی ہندسوں میں رہی ہے، جو ایک تاحیات فٹ کھلاڑی کی نشانی ہے۔ 54 تک پہنچنا ایک تبدیلی ہے۔ ا نہوں نے دل کی دھڑکن میں بے ترتیبی کی شکایت کی ہے۔ یہ ایسی بات نہیں جسے نوٹ کر کے نظرانداز کر دیا جائے۔ اس کے لیے فوری طور پر 24 گھنٹے کے لیۓ ہولٹر مانیٹر لگانا ضروری ہے، تاکہ اس کی تعداد معلوم ہو اور صحیح دوا تجویز کی جا سکے۔ یہاں تک کہ پاکستان سے باہر رجسٹرڈ ایپل فون سے منسلک ایپل واچ بھی Atrial Fibrillation اور دھڑکن کی بے ترتیبی کو حقیقی وقت میں ظاہر کر سکتی ہے (کیونکہ یہ فیچر پاکستان میں غیر فعال ہے)۔ اب وہ بلڈ پریشر کی تین الگ الگ دوائیں لے رہے ہیں۔ اس کے لیے روزانہ صبح و شام باقاعدہ نگرانی درکار ہے تاکہ خوراک درست کی جا سکے، ہفتہ وار اندازوں پر نہیں چلا جا سکتا۔ انہیں کولیسٹرول کم کرنے والی دوا بھی دی جا رہی ہے۔ اس عمر میں بڑھا ہوا کولیسٹرول جینیاتی اور ذہنی دباؤ دونوں وجوہات سے ہو سکتا ہے، اور اسے خوراک، ورزش اور دوا کے امتزاج سے قابو کرنا ضروری ہے، جیسا کہ بلڈ پریشر کے لیے بھی۔ کم نمک۔ زیادہ حرکت۔ حقیقی نگرانی۔ درج ذیل ٹیسٹ اب بغیر کسی مزید تاخیر کے ہونے چاہئیں: ۱) اسٹریس ٹیسٹ ۲) ایکو کارڈیوگرام ۳) کارڈیک ایم آر آئی ۴) Cardiac Artery Calcium CAC اسکین — بڑھے ہوئے کولیسٹرول کی وجہ سے، تاکہ شریانوں میں جمع کیلشیم کے ذخائر معلوم ہوں جو براہِ راست دل کے دورے یا اسٹنٹ کی ضرورت کا باعث بنتے ہیں۔ ۵) کارڈیک سی ٹی انجیوگرام اور، اگر ضرورت پڑے تو، دیگر ٹیسٹ۔ میں سخت پریشان ہوں۔ تنہائی ان کے جسم پر جسمانی اثرات مرتب کر رہی ہے۔ اگر اسے فوری طور پر حل نہ کیا گیا تو نقصان ناقابلِ تلافی ہو سکتا ہے۔ عمران خان کو اب فوری طور پر ہسپتال کے ماحول میمنتقل کیا جانا لازمی ہے، ایک آزاد اور غیرجانبدار طبی بورڈ کی نگرانی میں۔ ان کا خاندان اور پاکستان کے سرکاری ڈاکٹروں پر بلکل اعتماد نییں کرتے ہیں۔ سب پہلے بھی دیکھ چکے ہیں کہ رپورٹس میں ردوبدل کیا گیا، اعداد و شمار بڑھا چڑھا کر یا دبا کر پیش کیے گئے، پلیٹلیٹس کا معاملہ اس کی ایک مثال ہے۔ اگلے تین ماہ بہت اہم ہیں اور پتہ چلے گا کہ ان کی حالت بہتر ہوتی ہے یا مستقل نقصان میں بدل جاتی ہے۔ ہم سب پریشان ہیں۔ ملک کو آج ان کی ضرورتہے، پہلے سے کہیں زیادہ ہے۔ اللہ انہیں صحت مند رکھے۔ آمین۔

Addressing the gathering, Chief Minister Gupta called upon government departments, civic agencies, RWAs, market associations and citizens to actively participate in the campaign through Shramdaan and collective action. She said the campaign will focus on cleanliness drives across public spaces, source segregation of waste, reduction of single-use plastic and promotion of the 3R principle (Reduce, Reuse and Recycle). Chief Minister also announced that the best-performing wards will receive an incentive of Rs 1 crore in recognition of their outstanding cleanliness efforts, and appealed to every Delhiite to make cleanliness a part of everyday life. The launch programme was attended by Delhi BJP President and Union Minister of State Harsh Malhotra, Cabinet Minister Ashish Sood, MCD Mayor Pravesh Wahi, MLA Abhay Verma, along with senior officials, public representatives and other dignitaries. "সুপার কাপের আদলে চ্যালেঞ্জ কাপ দিয়ে মৌসুম শুরুর কথা ছিল, তবে সেটি বাতিল করেছে বাংলাদেশ ফুটবল ফেডারেশন (বাফুফে)। ম্যাচটিতে খেলার কথা ছিল গত মৌসুমের বাংলাদেশ ফুটবল লিগ ও ফেডারেশন কাপ চ্যাম্পিয়ন বসুন্ধরা কিংস ও লিগ রানার্সআপ আবাহনীর। তবে ফিফা নিষেধাজ্ঞার কারণে এখনও ফুটবলার নিবন্ধন শুরু করতে পারেনি এই দুই দল। যে কারণে বাতিল হয়েছে চ্যালেঞ্জ কাপ। সোমবার (১৭ আগস্ট) বিকেলে বাংলাদেশ ফুটবল লিগের ক্লাবগুলোর সঙ্গে বৈঠক শেষে ২১ আগস্ট নির্ধারিত চ্যালেঞ্জ কাপ আয়োজন না করার বিষয়টি নিশ্চিত করেছেন বাফুফে সভাপতি তাবিথ আউয়াল। তিনি জানান, ক্লাব লাইসেন্সিংয়ের প্রক্রিয়া শেষ করার জন্য আজ রাত পর্যন্ত সময় দেওয়া হচ্ছে। এরপর পরিস্থিতি পর্যালোচনা করে পরবর্তী সিদ্ধান্ত নেওয়া হবে। তাবিথ আউয়াল বলেন, ‘২১ আগস্ট চ্যালেঞ্জ কাপ মাঠে গড়াচ্ছে না। আজ ক্লাব লাইসেন্সিংয়ের শেষ দিন। আমরা আজ রাত পর্যন্ত অপেক্ষা করব। এরপর সিদ্ধান্ত নেব। ফেডারেশন কাপ ও লিগ পূর্বঘোষিত সূচি অনুযায়ী শুরুর ইচ্ছা আছে।’ সভায় বসুন্ধরা কিংসের পক্ষ থেকে কোচ গোলাম জিলানী আরও সাত কর্মদিবস সময় দেওয়ার অনুরোধ জানিয়েছেন। তার প্রত্যাশা, এই সময়ের মধ্যেই ফিফার দেওয়া দলবদল নিষেধাজ্ঞা উঠে যাবে। নিষেধাজ্ঞা প্রত্যাহার হলে ক্লাবটি ক্লাব লাইসেন্সিংয়ের আবেদন করার সুযোগ পাবে এবং এরপর খেলোয়াড় নিবন্ধনও করতে পারবে। বর্তমান সূচি অনুযায়ী, আগামী ২৫ আগস্ট মাঠে গড়ানোর কথা ফেডারেশন কাপ। এর তিন দিন পর, ২৮ আগস্ট শুরু হওয়ার কথা বাংলাদেশ ফুটবল লিগ। আর চলতি দলবদল কার্যক্রম শেষ হবে ৩ সেপ্টেম্বর। #BangladeshFootball #BashundharaKings #Abahani #somoytv

In Budapest, a rock has resurfaced in the Danube. It's called the Rock of Starvation - Ínség-szikla. For centuries, its return has meant one thing: the river is so low the mills fall silent, crops fail, and hunger follows. It surfaced in 1616. In 1718. In 1811, 1830, 1842, 1868. In 1947. And now it's back, in 2026. For the first time in 44 years, Hungary has shut down all but one of its Danube-cooled nuclear reactors. A nearby farmer puts it plainly: "I've lost nearly 50% of my harvest, and it could hit 70%. Since I started farming after the end of communist rule, I've never seen a catastrophe like this." The rock is a warning. It's been delivering it for 400 years. We know exactly what it says, but we haven't been listening.

Hear this fascinating story first hand in my interview with the MiG-25 Foxbat pilot in question who flew target mapping missions over Kargil: youtu.be/dH9JiRtuW18?si=dPpX… Anchit Gupta (@AnchitGupta9) This pic helped change the air war over Kargil. An IAF MiG-25 Foxbat took it in the third week of June 1999. And there is a reason to tell that story today. On 17 Aug 1981, 45 years ago, No. 102 Sqn was raised, beginning the MiG-25’s career in the IAF. 18 years later, the Foxbat was called upon to solve one of the most critical problems confronting the IAF in Kargil: accurately finding targets. It is also an important part of Safed Sagar that @NetflixIndia largely ignored. Identifying Pakistani positions and fixing their precise coordinates had become a serious problem. The Army’s maps were dated and inadequate for extracting accurate coordinates. Newer Survey of India maps would only reach the troops towards the end of June. The IAF therefore needed vertical aerial photography. It had the Avro 748, Jaguar, Canberra and MiG-25 available, but each had limitations. The Avro was unsuitable for a hostile environment. Jaguars with Vicon cameras produced excellent low-level imagery, but operating low over Kargil meant exposure to SAMs. A No. 106 Sqn Canberra had already been struck by an Anza missile on its first reconnaissance sortie. That left the MiG-25. The Foxbat normally operated above 20 km at around Mach 2.4. Its 72-inch focal-length cameras offered enormous photographic coverage, while its Peleng-DM navigation system could associate accurate positional information with the imagery. But at its normal altitude, the resolution was insufficient to identify small bunkers, sangars and concealed positions in Kargil. The Foxbat had to come down. At around 8 km, the imagery was superb, but the aircraft would be dangerously exposed to shoulder-fired missiles. A 13–14 km profile offered greater safety, but required minimum reheat and pushed the aircraft to about Mach 1.3. The eventual compromise was remarkable for a Foxbat: around 10 km and Mach 0.9. It gave roughly 5 km of vertical separation from the missile belts while allowing an effective fighter escort. The MiG-25 had no RWR, flares or chaff. Two MiG-29s provided top cover, with two Mirage 2000s accompanying it. If seriously threatened, the escape plan was pure Foxbat: maximum afterburner, climb to 20 km, accelerate to Mach 2.4 and get out. Navigation accuracy was equally critical. The Peleng-DM, like any inertial system, could drift. Its feed was integrated with the RSBN beacon system, and Wg Cdr P.J. Thakur went a step further, borrowing a handheld GPS from No. 7 Sqn to verify that the positions being generated were accurate. The MiG-25 was ferried to Adampur on 18 June. Weather ruled out operations on 19 and 20 June. On 21 June 1999, Wg Cdr P.J. Thakur flew the first operational photo-reconnaissance mission over the Drass–Kargil sector. Mirage 2000s flown by Wg Cdr S. Chhabra and Wg Cdr Rohit Verma accompanied the mission, while MiG-29s led by Wg Cdr S. Harpal Singh provided top cover. Two Pakistani F-16s approached during the photographic run. The MiG-29s deterred them, and the Foxbat stayed on task. The exposed film was then flown back to Bareilly for processing. When the photographs reached Western Air Command and Air HQ, the impact was evident. Tololing. Muntho Dhalo. Tiger Hill. Positions that had been difficult to locate with confidence were now clearly visible. Enlargements revealed bunkers, sangars and camouflaged positions. Crucially, the imagery could be tied to accurate coordinates. Strike crews could now study their targets before take-off, see how they would appear from release height, fix their coordinates and plan the direction of attack. Look again at the photograph. In the Kargil mountains, where locating a small position could be almost as difficult as attacking it, imagery of this quality mattered enormously. The MiG-25 went on to fly four more missions over Kargil–Drass, besides reconnaissance over Rajouri–Poonch and a sortie to establish the situation around Gultari. The Foxbat is remembered for Mach 2.4 and the stratosphere. Over Kargil, it made a critical contribution by doing almost the opposite: coming down to 10 km and slowing to Mach 0.9 so its cameras could see what mattered. We held a meeting with H.E. Masashi Nakagome, Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Japan to Ukraine @JPEmbUA. I expressed my gratitude for Japan’s unwavering support for Ukraine’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, as well as for the substantial practical assistance provided, in particular, to Ukraine’s energy sector. Through the Ministry of Energy’s hubs alone, Ukraine has received more than 113 tonnes of humanitarian aid, including 259 backup power units. Our partners provided assistance under various support programmes, including two gas turbines and mobile substations, 181 generators, 118 transformers, 6,400 gabions, and other essential equipment. We look forward to continued cooperation as Ukraine prepares for the 2026/2027 heating season, as russia continues its targeted attacks on our energy and gas infrastructure. We discussed the need to accelerate the procurement, with JICA’s @JICA_direct_en support, of 62 power transformers for frontline regions. One such transformer has already been delivered to the Kherson region, with another 27 supplied to the Mykolaiv region. Together with our Japanese partners, we are also working on procuring specialised equipment for gas production. We are equally interested in exploring opportunities for cooperation on the restoration and modernisation of Ukraine’s thermal power plants (TPPs) and combined heat and power plants (CHPs) during 2027-2030. We deeply value Japan’s support and our partners’ readiness to continue our cooperation in strengthening Ukraine’s energy resilience. I met with Haiti’s Prime Minister, Alix Didier Fils-Aimé, @citoyendidier, as we launched the work of the High-Level Inter-American Delegation during its visit to #Haiti this week. We discussed progress on Haiti’s two immediate priorities: strengthening security and advancing electoral preparations. I welcomed ongoing efforts to expand the capacity of the Haitian National Police as an important contribution to Haiti’s long-term stabilization. I thanked the Prime Minister for the trust placed in @OAS_official and expressed appreciation to our Inter-American and global partners and donors for supporting the Haitian National Police through our capacity-building programs. We also addressed the critical challenge of organizing elections as a key national objective and reaffirmed our commitment to supporting Haiti’s electoral preparedness and accompanying the country in its pursuit of secure, inclusive, and credible elections. I reiterated that the Inter-American community remains committed to supporting Haiti on its path toward security, democratic governance, and institutional stability.

Dr Elshafie Mohammed, our country representative in Somalia, provides an update ⬇️ “At Bay Regional hospital, where we work in collaboration with the Ministry of Health, teams received 71 wounded people, including women and children. Four deaths were recorded, including one young woman. Patients continue to arrive, and these figures are expected to rise. “Baidoa hosts more than half a million people displaced by conflict, drought and insecurity, many of whom depend on the town’s already limited health services. These services are stretched beyond capacity. Each new cycle of violence places further pressure on the health system and pushes lifesaving care further out of reach for those who need it. “It is devastating to see civilians caught up in violence again. Civilians, health facilities, and medical staff must be protected, and wounded people must be able to reach medical care safely. “At Bay Regional hospital, MSF supports the emergency, maternity, paediatrics, nutrition, and outpatient departments.”

भारतीय जनता पार्टी के सभी नवनियुक्त राष्ट्रीय महासचिवों को हार्दिक बधाई एवं शुभकामनाएं। आप सभी के अनुभव, संगठन कौशल और समर्पण से भाजपा को नई ऊर्जा, गति और मजबूती मिलेगी। राष्ट्रसेवा के इस महत्वपूर्ण दायित्व के सफल एवं सार्थक निर्वहन के लिए मंगलकामनाएं।

श्री बी. एल. संतोष जी को पुनः भारतीय जनता पार्टी के राष्ट्रीय महासचिव (संगठन) तथा श्री शिवप्रकाश जी एवं श्री सौदान सिंह जी को राष्ट्रीय सह-संगठन महामंत्री नियुक्त किए जाने पर हार्दिक बधाई एवं शुभकामनाएं। आप सभी का संगठन के प्रति समर्पण, अनुभव एवं मार्गदर्शन पार्टी को नई ऊर्जा, दिशा और गति प्रदान करेगा। आपके सफल, सार्थक एवं गौरवपूर्ण कार्यकाल के लिए हार्दिक मंगलकामनाएं।

Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta today launched ‘Delhi Ko Kude Se Azadi Swachhta Abhiyan 2026’, a city-wide campaign from 17 August to 2 October. Government departments, civic agencies, RWAs, market associations and citizens will join hands for cleanliness drives across public spaces, with a focus on Shramdaan, waste segregation, reducing single-use plastic and the 3R principle of Reduce, Reuse and Recycle. The best-performing wards will also receive an incentive of ₹1 crore for outstanding cleanliness efforts. The Delhi Government appeals to every citizen to come forward, contribute through Shramdaan and make cleanliness a part of everyday life. महाराष्ट्र में ऑटो-टैक्सी वालों को मराठी सीखने की डेडलाइन खत्म, अब बोलना ही होगा... कुठे जायचं साहेब? महाराष्ट्र में ऑटो-रिक्शा और टैक्सी चलाने वाले गैर-मराठी ड्राइवरों के लिए दी गई 105 दिन की मोहलत खत्म हो गई है. अब 18 अगस्त से परिवहन विभाग ऐसे ड्राइवरों के खिलाफ कार्रवाई शुरू करेगा, जिन्हें कामचलाऊ मराठी भी नहीं आती. नियम नहीं मानने पर ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस सस्पेंड होने से लेकर हमेशा के लिए रद्द तक हो सकता है. महाराष्ट्र के परिवहन मंत्री प्रताप सरनाईक ने सोमवार को कहा कि ड्राइवरों को मराठी का बुनियादी ज्ञान देने के लिए 1 मई से 15 अगस्त तक 105 दिन का समय दिया गया था. यह समय-सीमा अब खत्म हो चुकी है.समाचार एजेंसी के मुताबिक परिवहन विभाग जांच के दौरान यह देखेगा कि ऑटो और टैक्सी ड्राइवरों को रोजमर्रा के काम के लिए जरूरी मराठी आती है या नहीं. अगर किसी ड्राइवर को बुनियादी मराठी नहीं आती, तो उसे तुरंत लाइसेंस रद्द करने के बजाय पहले एक महीने का नोटिस दिया जाएगा. इस दौरान ड्राइवर को मराठी सीखकर अपनी दक्षता साबित करनी होगी. अगर एक महीने में मराठी सीख ली तो लाइसेंस चलता रहेगा. अगर नोटिस खत्म होने के बाद भी ड्राइवर जरूरी मराठी नहीं सीख पाता है तो उसका लाइसेंस तीन महीने के लिए सस्पेंड किया जा सकता है. तीन महीने के सस्पेंशन के बाद भी नियमों का पालन नहीं करने पर लाइसेंस हमेशा के लिए रद्द किया जा सकता है. इसका साफ मलतब है कि ड्राइवरों को 'कुठे जायचं साहेब?' यानी आपको कहां जाना है, मराठी में ही बोलना होगा. . . परिवहन मंत्री के मुताबिक महाराष्ट्र में ड्राइवरों के लिए मराठी की दक्षता से जुड़ा कानून 1989 से ही मौजूद है. हालांकि इसे लंबे समय से प्रभावी तरीके से लागू नहीं किया गया. सरनाईक ने कहा कि उन्होंने इस नियम को सख्ती से लागू करने का फैसला किया है ताकि राज्य में गाड़ी चलाने वाले ड्राइवरों को मराठी का कामकाजी ज्ञान हो. सरकार ने ड्राइवरों को मराठी सिखाने के लिए खास तैयारी भी की. परिवहन विभाग ने कोंकण मराठी साहित्य परिषद और मुंबई मराठी साहित्य संघ जैसे संगठनों के साथ मिलकर पढ़ने की सामग्री तैयार की. ड्राइवरों के लिए चार पेज की एक पुस्तिका तैयार की गई, जिसमें रोजमर्रा के परिवहन काम में इस्तेमाल होने वाले करीब 18 से 20 जरूरी मराठी वाक्य शामिल हैं. सरकार के मुताबिक राज्य में 160 सक्रिय शाखाओं और करीब 1600 प्रशिक्षकों के नेटवर्क के जरिए 11 लाख से ज्यादा ड्राइवरों को प्रशिक्षण दिया गया है. ट्रेनिंग पूरी करने वाले ड्राइवरों को QR कोड से सत्यापित सर्टिफिकेट भी दिए जाएंगे. मराठी की जांच सिर्फ अभी होने वाली कार्रवाई तक सीमित नहीं रहेगी. परिवहन मंत्री ने कहा कि ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस के नियमित रिन्यूअल के दौरान भी भाषा की जानकारी की जांच अनिवार्य होगी. सरकार के इस फैसले का ऑटो और टैक्सी यूनियनों की ओर से शुरुआती विरोध हुआ था. इसके बाद सरकार ने यूनियन नेताओं और अन्य प्रतिनिधियों से बातचीत की और ड्राइवरों को तैयारी के लिए 105 दिन का समय दिया. अब यह समय पूरा हो चुका है. मंत्री प्रताप सरनाईक ने साफ कहा है कि 18 अगस्त से कार्रवाई शुरू होगी और सरकार अपने फैसले से पीछे नहीं हटेगी. #Maharashtra #Auto #Marathi #MarathiLanguage

Brian Roemmele (@BrianRoemmele) Why the Romans gave their amphorae pointed bottoms It looks like a design mistake at first glance. Or they were too dumb to understand flat. Why make a heavy clay vessel that cannot stand on its own when a flat bottom would seem so much more practical? The Romans (and the Greeks before them) were solving a different problem. Amphorae were the shipping containers of the ancient Mediterranean. They carried wine, olive oil, fish sauce, and other liquids across open water in quantities that would make a modern logistics manager envious. The material was ceramic—strong under compression, but brittle and unforgiving when dropped or slammed against a dock. A flat-bottomed jar carries a fatal flaw: the sharp angle where the base meets the wall. That rim is a stress concentrator. One hard impact and the vessel cracks. After enough expensive losses, shippers discovered that a narrow, massively thickened point eliminated the weak edge entirely. The thick tip could take punishment that would destroy a conventional base. The long twin handles were equally purposeful. A dockworker could pass a heavy amphora from one hand to the other without setting it down. The same handles became ready-made tie-down points once the cargo was aboard. And when the vessel was laid on its side, the handles stopped it from rolling. The pointed base delivered the final advantages. A full amphora was heavy; the point let a man drag it across the quay instead of lifting its entire weight. In the hold, the geometry became brilliant: each pointed tip nestled into the space between the necks of the amphorae below it. The result was a dense, interlocking lattice that wasted almost no volume. What looks unstable on dry land was, at sea, a remarkably efficient system—rugged, space-saving, and perfectly adapted to the brutal realities of ancient trade. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/BrianRoemmele/status/2089369451636601195#m

Mark Warner said the intelligence relationship has “improved,” while other lawmakers cited a connection between Ukraine’s recent battlefield successes and renewed access to U.S. intelligence. The cooperation is particularly significant for Ukraine’s expanding long range strike campaign. U.S. intelligence reportedly contributes to targeting packages for strikes against Russian forces in Ukraine and energy infrastructure inside Russia, while Ukraine continues to provide intelligence to Washington. The shift follows a period in which Kyiv’s increasingly effective drone and missile strikes have demonstrated an ability to impose significant costs deep inside Russia, particularly against its energy infrastructure. The reporting also highlights that the relationship is increasingly becoming two-way. عبدالسلام حنفی، معاون اداری ریاست‌الوزرا، در مراسم هجدهمین دور فراغت دانش‌جویان دانشگاه بامیان، از روند توسعه و بازسازی کشور با استفاده از عواید داخلی و ظرفیت‌های سکتورهای عایداتی سخن گفته و بر ادامه تلاش‌ها در این زمینه تأکید کرده است. بر بنیاد خبرنامه دفتر رسانه‌ای مقام ولایت بامیان، در این دور ۹۱۴ دانش‌جو فارغ شده‌اند. وزیر تحصیلات عالی نیز در این مراسم از برنامه‌های این وزارت برای ارتقای کیفیت علمی، اجرای پروژه‌های انکشافی و رسیدگی به نیازمندی‌های دانشگاه بامیان خبر داده است. او افزوده است که وزارت تحصیلات عالی برای بهبود کیفیت علمی و آموزشی و فراهم‌سازی محیط مناسب تحصیلی برای دانش‌جویان تلاش می‌کند. همچنین، در جریان سفر معاون اداری ریاست‌الوزرا و وزیر تحصیلات عالی به بامیان، کار ساخت احاطه دانشگاه بامیان به‌گونه رسمی آغاز شد. این پروژه به طول سه هزار متر و با هزینه حدود ۱۸ میلیون افغانی از بودجه انکشافی وزارت تحصیلات عالی تمویل می‌شود. #طلوع‌نیوز

The United States and Japan carried out their first coordinated currency intervention in more than a decade: buying yen to arrest its slide to a forty-year low. "The U.S. Treasury has the legal ability to intervene in the foreign exchange market, but in the last few decades it has generally refrained from intervention," writes CFR's @Brad_Setser. "The main benefit of this operation is likely that it stops—at least for a while—the risk of a potentially disruptive further depreciation of the yen. A weak yen tends to put pressure on other Asian currencies, and it could make it harder for China to continue to allow a slow appreciation of its currency." "Ultimately, reestablishing a credible intervention threat and a series of rate hikes should stabilize the yen. It is really very weak, and it has overshot Japan's underlying fundamentals," argues Setser.

Iran's IRGC denies President Trump's claim that U.S. officials are holding secret backchannel talks with the Revolutionary Guards. "There are no ongoing talks between the IRGC and the Americans, and this lie of Trump's is merely a fantasy that has afflicted him due to the illusions and nightmares resulting from defeat and despair in the war," IRGC spokesman Hossein Mohebbi told the IRGC-affiliated Tasnim News. Mohebbi said diplomacy falls under Iran's Foreign Ministry, which also denies any current talks with the U.S. "due to the broken promises and dark experiences that exist from the repeated and constant U.S. violation of promises." The IRGC spokesman said Trump "is trying to temporarily control the price of oil and energy in the world with these statements, but he has only one real way forward, and that is to accept defeat and implement the conditions set by Iran."

यह एक ऐसी पुस्तक है, जिसे हम सभी को एक बार जरूर पढ़ना चाहिए। इससे हमें सीखने को मिलेगा कि जीवन में सही दिशा और निरंतर प्रयास के साथ कैसे आगे बढ़ा जा सकता है। सामान्यतः आज की युवा पीढ़ी सफलता का सरल और त्वरित रास्ता तलाशती है, ऐसा रास्ता, जो तुरंत मंजिल तक पहुंचा दे। लेकिन वेंकैया जी ने कभी आसान रास्ता नहीं चुना। उन्होंने सही और कठिन रास्ते को अपनाया और अपने संघर्ष, समर्पण और निरंतर परिश्रम से भारतीय जनता पार्टी को एक मुकाम तक पहुंचाने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई। इसलिए आज की युवा पीढ़ी को यह समझना चाहिए कि राजनीति हो या जीवन, शॉर्टकट से नहीं, बल्कि लंबे संघर्ष, धैर्य और निरंतर प्रयास से ही स्थायी सफलता हासिल होती है। -श्री @NitinNabin

The Department of War announced a $22.9 billion Navy contract with Raytheon, an RTX business, to accelerate Tomahawk Land Attack Missile (TLAM) production, framing it as part of the Pentagon’s broader effort to rapidly expand munitions output. The announcement comes after the Pentagon has been pressing defense contractors to expand production of critical munitions amid the demands of the Iran war and concerns over depleted inventories. Under Secretary of War for Acquisition and Sustainment Michael Duffey said the award is a response to that push, while Acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao described it as an effort to accelerate Tomahawk deliveries at an “unprecedented speed.” Notably, the $22.9 billion figure is the value of the contract, but the announcement does not specify how many additional Tomahawks it will ultimately produce or how quickly those missiles will be delivered.

Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta today launched ‘Delhi Ko Kude Se Azadi Swachhta Abhiyan 2026’, a city-wide campaign from 17 August to 2 October. Government departments, civic agencies, RWAs, market associations and citizens will join hands for cleanliness drives across public spaces, with a focus on Shramdaan, waste segregation, reducing single-use plastic and the 3R principle of Reduce, Reuse and Recycle. The best-performing wards will also receive an incentive of ₹1 crore for outstanding cleanliness efforts. The Delhi Government appeals to every citizen to come forward, contribute through Shramdaan and make cleanliness a part of everyday life. Delhi BJP President and Union Minister of State Shri Harsh Malhotra, Cabinet Minister Shri Ashish Sood, MCD Mayor Shri Pravesh Wahi, MLA Shri Abhay Verma and other dignitaries were present on the occasion. @hdmalhotra @ashishsood_bjp @praveshwahi @abhayvermabjp #DelhiKoKoodeSeAzadi

The Wall Street Journal reports that Iran’s leadership used the period following the June memorandum of understanding not to prepare for deescalation, but for a larger conflict with the United States. According to Iranian and Arab officials and intercepted communications cited by the Journal, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has expanded its control over Iran’s military, accelerated missile and drone production, and worked with allied groups in Iraq and Yemen to broaden the battlefield. That has included positioning missiles, naval weapons and drones around the Red Sea, providing Houthi forces with intelligence and target information, and preparing attacks against Saudi ports and energy infrastructure. Iranian-backed militias in Iraq have also targeted Saudi energy sites. The Journal also reports a broader shift inside Tehran toward an offensive posture. Recent senior security appointments have strengthened IRGC control over the regular military, while commanders have publicly called for operations against targets in countries hosting U.S. forces. The immediate effect has been a widening conflict: attacks on shipping in Hormuz, strikes against U.S. forces in Jordan and elsewhere, and increasing pressure on Gulf energy infrastructure.

QUISO JUGAR A LAS GUERRITAS CON ESTADOS UNIDOS… PUES YA LO LOGRÓ La presidente Claudia @Claudiashein decidió convertir la revocación de la visa de Andy López Beltrán en un pleito político con Estados Unidos. Salió a defender al hijo de su mentor, gritó “soberanía”, acusó de “injerencia” y pretendió hacer creer a los mexicanos que una decisión de Estados Unidos sobre quién puede entrar a SU territorio constituye una afrenta contra México. Mentira. Estados Unidos también es soberano. Una visa estadounidense no es un derecho. Es un privilegio que ese país concede y puede revocar. Y el mensaje desde Washington es todavía más incómodo: el Departamento de Estado ha reiterado que cada decisión de visa es una decisión de seguridad nacional y que busca impedir el ingreso de individuos que amenacen los intereses de Estados Unidos. Entonces, presidente @Claudiashein: Si quería jugar a las guerritas diplomáticas, engañando a los mexicanos con una falsa “injerencia” y poniendo innecesariamente en riesgo la relación con nuestro principal socio comercial por defender la visa de Andy López Beltrán, ya lo logró. Pero tenga mucho cuidado con el pleito que decidió abrir. Porque hasta ahora Estados Unidos se ha negado, por confidencialidad, a revelar públicamente por qué le revocó la visa a Andy. Y después de las visas retiradas a otros políticos mexicanos y de las acciones judiciales estadounidenses contra funcionarios y personajes de la política mexicana, la pregunta se vuelve cada vez más incómoda: ¿QUÉ LE SABE ESTADOS UNIDOS A ANDY LÓPEZ BELTRÁN Y A OTROS PERSONAJES DE MORENA? Usted decidió convertir una visa en un asunto de “soberanía nacional”. Cuidado con que Estados Unidos termine respondiéndole con la información que hasta ahora se ha reservado. @Mauricio_35m Video

The traditional Indian IT model relied heavily on hiring large numbers of graduates, training them and gradually moving them into more specialised roles. اعضای طالبان با انتشار ویدیویی در شبکه‌های اجتماعی ادعا کردند که جمعه‌خان فاتح، فرمانده ناراضی این گروه در بدخشان تسلیم شده است. در ویدیوی منتشرشده، یک عضو طالبان به زبان پشتو می‌گوید که فاتح در داخل موتر است؛ اما چهره‌ی فاتح در این ویدیو دیده نمی‌شود. فاتح از یک هفته به این‌طرف با نیروهای طالبان در نسی بدخشان درگیر بود. رادیو حریت، رسانه‌ی نزدیک به طالبان نیز گزارش داده است که فاتح به نیروهای این گروه تسلیم شده است. هم‌زمان گزارش شده است که فاتح با فصیح‌الدین فطرت، رییس ارتش طالبان گفت‌وگو می‌کند. بی‌بی‌سی امروز (دوشنبه، ۲۶ اسد) به نقل از منابع امنیتی گزارش داده است که جمعه‌خان فاتح اواخر شب گذشته به همراه افراد مسلح خود از مواضع کوهستانی‌شان پایین آمده‌اند. طبق گزارش این رسانه، فاتح و فطرت در حال مذاکره هستند و خلع سلاح کامل افراد وابسته به فاتح، از شروط اصلی طالبان در این گفت‌وگو است. होर्मुज संकट से भी नहीं होगा LPG क्राइसिस, सरकार ने खेला बड़ा दांव; इन कंपनियों को मिली बड़ी जिम्मेदारी LPG Supply Crisis: मिडिल ईस्ट में जारी जंग और समुद्री रास्तों पर बन रही दिक्क्त के कारण देश में एलपीजी सप्लाई सिस्टम (LPG Supply System) प्रभावित हुआ है. भारत अपनी जरूरत का अधिकतर हिस्सा आयात करता है. इस आयात में से करीब 90% हिस्सा परंपरागत रूप से मिडिल ईस्ट और स्ट्रेट ऑफ होर्मुज (Strait of Hormuz) के रास्ते आता रहा है. ऐसे में होर्मुज में किसी भी तरह की रुकावट का असर एलपीजी (LPG) की उपलब्धता और डिलीवरी पर पड़ता है. मार्च और अप्रैल में एलपीजी क्राइसिस का सामना करने के बाद केंद्र सरकार ने पब्लिक और प्राइवेट सेक्टर की रिफाइनरियों के लिए एलपीजी प्रोडक्शन से जुड़े टारगेट तय किये हैं. आने वाले समय में एलपीजी को लेकर किसी तरह की परेशानी न हो, इसके लिये सरकार की तरफ से दिये गए आदेश में संकट के समय देश में अधिकतम 63,810 टन एलपीजी का रोजाना प्रोडक्शन करने का टारगेट रखा गया है. यह टारगेट फाइनेंशियल ईयर 2026 में देश के कुल घरेलू एलपीजी प्रोडक्शन के दोगुने से भी ज्यादा है. भारत में हर दिन करीब 91,000 टन एलपीजी की खपत होती है. इस हिसाब से सरकार की तरफ से तय किया गया टारगेट देश की रोजाना खपत का करीब 70% है. सरकार की यह तैयारी तत्काल एलपीजी संकट से निपटने को लेकर नहीं है. सरकार की कोशिश ऐसा सिस्टम बनाने की है, जिसमें भविष्य में दूसरे देशों से एलपीजी की सप्लाई बाधित होने पर घरेलू एलपीजी (LPG) प्रोडक्शन को तेजी से बढ़ाया जा सके और घरेलू ग्राहकों को प्रियोरिटी के आधार पर गैस मुहैया कराई जा सके. . . भारत अपनी कुल एलपीजी जरूरत का 90% मिडिल ईस्ट से आयात करता है. फाइनेंशियल ईयर 2025-26 के दौरान भारत ने करीब 33.2 मिलियन टन एलपीजी (LPG) की खपत की है. इसमें से करीब 13.1 मिलियन टन घरेलू प्रोडक्शन था, जबकि 21.3 मिलियन टन गैस का आयात करना पड़ा था. इस हिसाब से कुल खपत का 64% से ज्यादा हिस्सा आयात से आया. आयात में मिडिल ईस्ट की हिस्सेदारी सबसे ज्यादा रही. जंग से पहले भारत का करीब 90% LPG आयात होर्मुज के जरिये आता था. इसलिए समुद्री मार्ग प्रभावित होने से पूरी घरेलू LPG सप्लाई चेन पर असर पड़ता है. यही कारण है कि सरकार किसी भी संकट के समय में इम्पोर्ट के साथ ही सप्लाई रूट पर निर्भरता को भी कम करना चाहती है. भारत की FY 26 के दौरान एलपीजी की खपत करीब 33.2 मिलियन टन रही. यह औसतन रोजाना करीब 91,000 टन के करीब रही. इसके मुकाबले सरकार की तरफ से तय टारगेट 63,810 टन रोजाना की अधिकतम प्रोडक्शन लिमिट करीब 70% दैनिक औसत खपत के बराबर बैठती है. इसका मतलब यह नहीं हुआ कि भारत अपनी एलपीजी (LPG) जरूरत का 70% हमेशा घरेलू प्रोडक्शन से पूरा करेगा. यह क्राइसिस के समय एक्टिव होने वाला प्रोडक्शन फ्रेमवर्क है. यदि आयात पर अचानक असर पड़ता है तो सरकार के पास पहले से यह विकल्प रहेगा कि किस रिफाइनरी से कितनी एलपीजी उपलब्ध कराई जा सकती है. इसके लिए रिलायंस को सबसे ज्यादा एलपीजी प्रोडक्शन का टारगेट मिला है. #LPG #LPGCrisis

How can fisheries and aquaculture create more jobs, better incomes and stronger food systems? Small-scale fisheries and aquaculture already support 600 million people and account for nearly 40% of global capture fisheries production. Since 2010, IFAD has invested over US$2.1 billion in the sector through an integrated approach that links production, value chain development, and enabling policy and institutional frameworks. The result? About 21 million people – primarily small-scale fishers, fish farmers, processors, distributors and retailers – have participated in IFAD-supported projects. Across the portfolio, combined investments in sustainable resource management, post-harvest infrastructure and market linkages show how a value chain-oriented approach can deliver results. In Djibouti, for example, PRAREV-Pêche reached nearly 30,000 people in climate-vulnerable coastal communities. Among participants involved for more than one year, the project contributed to: ✅ 32% higher household incomes ✅ 36% higher revenues from fish sales ✅ 35% lower food insecurity scores Read more about IFAD’s work on small-scale fisheries and aquaculture at ifad.org/en/w/publications/t…

His name is Mohammad Ghmeira. Don’t let them bury it with him. Mohammad Hussam al-Din Ghmeira walked into Haffa police station in Latakia, Syria, over a “routine” money complaint. He left in a coma. Today he left in a coffin. He was a hemophiliac, his blood doesn’t clot. His family told the officers, and asked them not to beat him. They beat him anyway. His father, Hussam Ghmeira, died in Ghouta fighting Assad. The son survived Assad, joined @SyriaCivilDef, only to die in the holding cell of a post-Assad Syrian police station. The uniform changed. The table didn’t. The broken body didn’t. The word “investigation” as a reason to die didn’t. He entered conscious and in stable health. He came out bleeding, then no speech, then acute brain hemorrhage, then a heart that stopped three times. A healthy man does not bleed into his skull in custody by accident. And Ghmeira is not alone. The Syrian Network for Human Rights @snhr documented at least 32 people dead under torture in Syria in 2025, and at least 1,108 arbitrary arrests and detentions across the country in the same year. Different jailers, different flags, same cell, same bruises, same silence afterward. Seven officers detained. The Interior Minister @Anas_Khattab_sy sent condolences and promised accountability. Syria has heard “an investigation has been opened” for eighteen months, and not one public trial. An investigation with no verdict is a burial for the case, not justice for the dead. We don’t want condolences. We want the officers’ names, a public courtroom, and an independent autopsy. The men who ran the old dungeons are gone. The dungeons are still full. The new Syria isn’t judged by its statements, it’s judged by whether Mohammad (or any other detainee) can die in a police cell and anyone answers for it.

On 10 August 2026, a newly-appointed Ambassador of the Kingdom of Morocco to ASEAN, H.E. Redouane Houssaini, presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Houssaini on his assumption of office and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s commitment to further strengthening the ASEAN-Morocco Sectoral Dialogue Partnership established in 2023. The Secretary-General also expressed appreciation for Morocco’s support for ASEAN Community-building efforts. Ambassador Houssaini thanked Secretary-General Dr. Kao for the warm welcome. He looked forward to working closely with ASEAN Member States and the ASEAN Secretariat in further strengthening Morocco’s ties and cooperation with ASEAN during his term of office. Morocco has accredited its first Ambassador to ASEAN since 2010. Ambassador Houssaini succeeds Ambassador Ouadia Benabdellah, who completed his tenure in April 2025. Video

In rural Morocco, cooperatives are turning saffron into a driver of local transformation, capturing more value, creating jobs and keeping economic activity in the community. Through a partnership between IFAD and the Government of Morocco, saffron cultivation was introduced to the Azilal region and supported through several cooperatives working with local farmers. Among them, the Ait Bouali cooperative has brought together 184 farmers and helped build a local enterprise that employs dozens of people year-round. What began with just 17 hectares has expanded to more than 300 hectares, generating up to US$2,500 per hectare, far beyond what traditional crops could offer. The project also delivered measurable results across the region, with local incomes increasing by nearly 24%, poverty falling by 18% and almost 70% of supported farms boosting productivity by 20% or more. By supporting cooperatives and local value chains, IFAD and the Government of Morocco enabled small-scale producers to move into higher-value markets while creating employment and broader benefits for rural communities. The cost of servicing US debt is the highest in decades: On Thursday, the US government sold $25 billion of 30Y Treasury bonds at a 5.216% yield, the highest auction yield since 2001. This follows a $42 billion auction of 10Y Treasury notes on Wednesday that resulted in a 4.683% yield, the highest since 2007. Previously, on July 9th, the government sold 30Y Treasury bonds at a 5.058% yield, the highest since 2007, highlighting the worsening trend in US debt financing costs. By comparison, yields on the same-maturity Treasury auctions were below 2.00% during the 2020 pandemic. This comes as investors are demanding more compensation to finance the US government's ever-growing deficit. In July, the US Treasury’s budget deficit surged +$141 billion YoY, to $432 billion, the largest July total in history. The US debt crisis is entering uncharted territory.

1. Gen. Douglas MacArthur immortalised the line ‘old soldiers never die, they just fade away’. Last week, an Indian soldier, among the greatest & most decorated, personified this irony. The 40th anniversary of his assassination passed unnoticed. No commemoration, no memorials, not even a tweet from the ever-so-active Army handles. It’s as if there was a ‘corporate’ call to erase all memory of Gen. AS Vaidya. It should raise questions. #NationalInterest 2. Gen. Vaidya was one among only 6 Indians to be awarded 2 MVCs, earned in the most intense battlefields, 1965 & 1971. He rose to be India’s 13th Army chief. He retired on 31 January, 1986, & yet died in the line of duty on 10 August that year as 2 assassins shot him at the wheel of his Maruti 800 in Pune. 3. Soldiers, however senior, can’t determine their destinies, & especially so in democracies. Punjab deteriorated & although the Army had nothing to do with law & order there, responsibility for clearing the Golden Temple fell on Vaidya’s shoulders. Sikh militants drew up hit lists. Gen. Vaidya’s name was on it. 4. Two assassins from ‘Khalistan Commando Force’ were closing in on Vaidya. And yet nobody, not the intelligence, Maharashtra police or even the Army showed awareness that their recently-retired chief was still completing his home in Pune’s Koregaon Park. His security had been left to Pune police. So callous was this that all Vaidya was given was a solitary police gunman. 5. Constable Ramchandra Kshirsagar was in the backseat of the Maruti as the assassins pulled along on an Ind-Suzuki motorcycle & shot Vaidya in the head. Kshirsagar, dazed, tried to get out of the car, but his foot got caught in the door & he was dragged for a bit. India’s greatest war hero was abandoned. 6. Vaidya was warned multiple times of the threat to his life. He was philosophical. “I fought two wars & came out without a scratch, & if a bullet has my name on it, it will find me.” Did our “system” fail him in making the assassins’ task so easy? And did it fail him yet again this week? Should all old soldiers, even your greatest war heroes, be made to fade away into anonymity like Vaidya? It’s a question also for the Army as an institution. 7. Read #NationalInterest:theprint.in/national-interes… Watch #NationalInterest: ￼ youtube.com/watch?v=SrEfEHts…

When you do a write up you write the logical path for the reader to follow your finding. You don’t write the path you took to get there. If a friend asks for a recommendation you don’t list everything you did before you figured it out. IRIS C2 (@C2IRIS) If you are a young vulnerability researcher, it's important to remember this: When people write blog posts or give conference talks on the brilliant multi-bug exploit chains that they discover, they generally talk about it as though they just elegantly pranced from one brilliant insight to another. The reality, of course, is almost always much less elegant, and involved a lot more banging of one's head against the wall to finally stumble into each brilliant insight. But you can't blame people for doing this, because talking about the 1,001 things that didn't work would make the talk or blog post way too long and incomprehensible. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/C2IRIS/status/2088739719777567070#m

The Western military is no longer a reliable fighting force. It is a cargo-cult ritual performed by men who still believe expensive choreography can substitute for the ability to kill and endure. Generals mostly pretend to prepare for the next war in the same way priests recite ancient liturgies. They polish doctrines written for uncontested skies and polite opponents who agreed to die on schedule. The result is a force exquisitely optimized for PowerPoint victories and completely unprepared for an enemy who simply refuses to cooperate with the script. Ukraine exposed the fraud in real time. Billions in “game-changing” systems arrived, performed their brief theater, and were ground down by mass, electronic warfare, and cheap attrition the West had declared obsolete. The Red Sea added the punchline of the most expensive navy in history reduced to frantic, magazine-emptying defense against the military equivalent of bottle rockets. NITI Aayog has released the report “Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub,” presenting a roadmap to strengthen India’s manufacturing ecosystem and advance the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. The study assesses 62 manufacturing sectors and identifies 12 high-potential sectors where India can build scale, enhance competitiveness, create quality employment, and deepen integration with global value chains. The analysis draws on sectoral assessment, international benchmarking, and industry consultations. The identified sectors are: Automobiles, Chemicals, Capital Goods, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, Defence & Drones, Food Processing, Textiles, Steel, Leather & Footwear, Telecom Equipment, and Solar PV Manufacturing. Al Jazeera reports that after months of war with the United States and amid the ongoing naval blockade of Iran’s southern ports, food prices and unemployment have risen, leaving millions of people facing economic hardship. According to Iran’s Statistical Center, annual inflation reached around 88 percent in July, while food inflation exceeded 128 percent. Youth unemployment was also recorded at 23.4 percent in the spring. Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has said the war and naval blockade have increased government costs and negatively affected the country’s ability to sell oil and generate tax revenues. According to the report, Iran’s economy remains under severe pressure but is still far from collapse. #TOLOnews_English

QUISO JUGAR A LAS GUERRITAS CON ESTADOS UNIDOS… PUES YA LO LOGRÓ La presidente Claudia @Claudiashein decidió convertir la revocación de la visa de Andy López Beltrán en un pleito político con Estados Unidos. Salió a defender al hijo de su mentor, gritó “soberanía”, acusó de “injerencia” y pretendió hacer creer a los mexicanos que una decisión de Estados Unidos sobre quién puede entrar a SU territorio constituye una afrenta contra México. Mentira. Estados Unidos también es soberano. Una visa estadounidense no es un derecho. Es un privilegio que ese país concede y puede revocar. Y el mensaje desde Washington es todavía más incómodo: el Departamento de Estado ha reiterado que cada decisión de visa es una decisión de seguridad nacional y que busca impedir el ingreso de individuos que amenacen los intereses de Estados Unidos. Entonces, presidente @Claudiashein: Si quería jugar a las guerritas diplomáticas, engañando a los mexicanos con una falsa “injerencia” y poniendo innecesariamente en riesgo la relación con nuestro principal socio comercial por defender la visa de Andy López Beltrán, ya lo logró. Pero tenga mucho cuidado con el pleito que decidió abrir. Porque hasta ahora Estados Unidos se ha negado, por confidencialidad, a revelar públicamente por qué le revocó la visa a Andy. Y después de las visas retiradas a otros políticos mexicanos y de las acciones judiciales estadounidenses contra funcionarios y personajes de la política mexicana, la pregunta se vuelve cada vez más incómoda: ¿QUÉ LE SABE ESTADOS UNIDOS A ANDY LÓPEZ BELTRÁN Y A OTROS PERSONAJES DE MORENA? Usted decidió convertir una visa en un asunto de “soberanía nacional”. Cuidado con que Estados Unidos termine respondiéndole con la información que hasta ahora se ha reservado. @Mauricio_35m Video

I warned in 2019 that Europe’s “equidistance” strategy will be short-lived. After 2022, it turned into “de-risking” but Europe isn’t Kazakhstan due to strategic alliances & geoeconomic scale. As I foresaw, Europe will ultimately side with US amid new Cold War with the DragonBear. Sari Arho Havrén (@SariArhoHavren) The US forcing its partners to choose means that the ambiguity space is now closing. 📌 European capitals have built China policy on “de-risking, not decoupling”. This doctrine works if the US tolerates a middle position, which it doesn't. Pax Silica membership “cannot be held alongside membership in duplicative initiatives whose expectations conflict with our own”. 📌 Europe should read this as a precedent, as it pairs with the Bloomberg-reported questionnaire assessing NATO allies’ political alignment ahead of the December troop review. Access to American security guarantees, frontier models, and chip supply is transactional (audited and revocable). 📌 This tiered-sovereignty logic interestingly mirrors Beijing’s. Access-conditionality is exactly the geoeconomic coercion playbook Europe has spent five years learning to resist from China, not exactly with great success. Europe now faces symmetric pressure from both. 📌 The asymmetry runs one way: Europe cannot substitute for US frontier models or the US-centric chip stack; China cannot offer them either, since Beijing’s most advanced chip manufacturing still trails that of Pax Silica partners, and export controls constrain what it can share. Europe will choose the US as it has through Pax Silica. But economic security will now cut the supply chains as well. 📌 The Kazakhstan case tells more than immediately meets the eye. Astana joined Pax Silica as a key potential source of critical minerals, then signed on to China’s coalition. Europe’s own raw-materials diversification runs through the Middle Corridor. If Washington forces Central Asian states into binary choices, Europe’s minerals strategy inherits the consequences. Worth watching whether Astana’s hedge holds. We are a poor country, trying to be a less-poor country and not doing such a great job. I've said this since the days Mera Bharat Mahaan ads played on Doordarshan, not because I'm an economist, but because I found the streets more interesting than the screen. Muthukrishnan Dhandapani (@dmuthuk) It is not that India has not been progressing. But we are simply running to stay in the same place. Where we stand globally is one way of looking at it. At the time of independence, our GDP stood at 9th place. Now we are at 6th place. Most important is GDP per capita. From 97th rank in 1960, we are now at 147th. The 147th rank not only indicates how poor we are; given the huge inequality, probably 80% of the population is simply struggling to survive. As I pointed out the other day, even if you adjust for Purchasing Power Parity, our rank is still 125th. We have completely missed the manufacturing bus. In 1950, manufacturing was 12% of GVA and now it is 14%. Except for Tamil Nadu and Gujarat, where manufacturing is growing on par with how China used to grow in its peak years, our manufacturing story is yet to begin. Lee Kuan Yew once said: “India cannot grow into a major economy on services alone. Since the industrial revolution, no country has become a major economy without becoming an industrial power.” What was obvious about India to Singapore policymakers did not hit the vision of our policymakers. Our share of global merchandise exports was 1.85% in 1950. After 75 years, we are still stuck at 1.69%. And for nearly the last five decades, our GDP per capita growth has been only around 4.5% annualised, barely sufficient to move the needle from such a low base. That is why we are still at $2,800 GDP per capita, a low income country ranked 147th globally. The Centre and every single state have an enormous amount of work to do in numerous areas. This is not to become a superpower or a rich nation, but to achieve a decent GDP per capita of $10,000 around 2050. As I pointed out the other day, despite whatever narrative we set, the crux is this: During the last 12 years, our GDP has just doubled and our GDP per capita has not even doubled. Those who ask why we should look at the numbers in dollars need to understand that the exchange rate itself reflects productivity, competitiveness, and capital flows. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/dmuthuk/status/2088804792172998736#m

US President Donald Trump said he was "not happy" about US participation in joint military exercises with close ally South Korea and is scaling back the drills aimed at deterring rival North Korea that start Monday. "Based on my very good relationship with Kim Jong Un, of North Korea, I am not happy with the fact that the United States has, long ago, agreed to participate in Joint Military Exercises with South Korea," Trump wrote on his Truth Social platform. "These exercises are not only costly, with much of these costs paid for by the United States of America (as usual!), but send a signal that is totally inappropriate and hostile, to a Country that, as long as Donald J. Trump has been President, has been unthreatening and respectful," he continued. Trump added that it was too late to cancel the drills so he had ordered Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth to "substantially reduce" them. The "Ulchi Freedom Shield" exercise, which starts on Monday and runs for 11 days, is a regular summer fixture for South Korea's armed forces and their US allies, designed to steel them for defense against the nuclear-armed North.

Mentira. Estados Unidos también es soberano. Una visa estadounidense no es un derecho. Es un privilegio que ese país concede y puede revocar. Y el mensaje desde Washington es todavía más incómodo: el Departamento de Estado ha reiterado que cada decisión de visa es una decisión de seguridad nacional y que busca impedir el ingreso de individuos que amenacen los intereses de Estados Unidos. Entonces, presidente @Claudiashein: Si quería jugar a las guerritas diplomáticas, engañando a los mexicanos con una falsa “injerencia” y poniendo innecesariamente en riesgo la relación con nuestro principal socio comercial por defender la visa de Andy López Beltrán, ya lo logró. Pero tenga mucho cuidado con el pleito que decidió abrir. Porque hasta ahora Estados Unidos se ha negado, por confidencialidad, a revelar públicamente por qué le revocó la visa a Andy. Y después de las visas retiradas a otros políticos mexicanos y de las acciones judiciales estadounidenses contra funcionarios y personajes de la política mexicana, la pregunta se vuelve cada vez más incómoda: ¿QUÉ LE SABE ESTADOS UNIDOS A ANDY LÓPEZ BELTRÁN Y A OTROS PERSONAJES DE MORENA? His name is Mohammad Ghmeira. Don’t let them bury it with him. Mohammad Hussam al-Din Ghmeira walked into Haffa police station in Latakia, Syria, over a “routine” money complaint. He left in a coma. Today he left in a coffin. He was a hemophiliac, his blood doesn’t clot. His family told the officers, and asked them not to beat him. They beat him anyway. His father, Hussam Ghmeira, died in Ghouta fighting Assad. The son survived Assad, joined @SyriaCivilDef, only to die in the holding cell of a post-Assad Syrian police station. The uniform changed. The table didn’t. The broken body didn’t. The word “investigation” as a reason to die didn’t. He entered conscious and in stable health. He came out bleeding, then no speech, then acute brain hemorrhage, then a heart that stopped three times. A healthy man does not bleed into his skull in custody by accident. And Ghmeira is not alone. The Syrian Network for Human Rights @snhr documented at least 32 people dead under torture in Syria in 2025, and at least 1,108 arbitrary arrests and detentions across the country in the same year. Different jailers, different flags, same cell, same bruises, same silence afterward. Seven officers detained. The Interior Minister @Anas_Khattab_sy sent condolences and promised accountability. Syria has heard “an investigation has been opened” for eighteen months, and not one public trial. An investigation with no verdict is a burial for the case, not justice for the dead. We don’t want condolences. We want the officers’ names, a public courtroom, and an independent autopsy. The men who ran the old dungeons are gone. The dungeons are still full. The new Syria isn’t judged by its statements, it’s judged by whether Mohammad (or any other detainee) can die in a police cell and anyone answers for it.

His name is Mohammad Ghmeira. Don’t let them bury it with him. Mohammad Hussam al-Din Ghmeira walked into Haffa police station in Latakia, Syria, over a “routine” money complaint. He left in a coma. Today he left in a coffin. He was a hemophiliac, his blood doesn’t clot. His family told the officers, and asked them not to beat him. They beat him anyway. His father, Hussam Ghmeira, died in Ghouta fighting Assad. The son survived Assad, joined @SyriaCivilDef, only to die in the holding cell of a post-Assad Syrian police station. The uniform changed. The table didn’t. The broken body didn’t. The word “investigation” as a reason to die didn’t. He entered conscious and in stable health. He came out bleeding, then no speech, then acute brain hemorrhage, then a heart that stopped three times. A healthy man does not bleed into his skull in custody by accident. And Ghmeira is not alone. The Syrian Network for Human Rights @snhr documented at least 32 people dead under torture in Syria in 2025, and at least 1,108 arbitrary arrests and detentions across the country in the same year. Different jailers, different flags, same cell, same bruises, same silence afterward. Seven officers detained. The Interior Minister @Anas_Khattab_sy sent condolences and promised accountability. Syria has heard “an investigation has been opened” for eighteen months, and not one public trial. An investigation with no verdict is a burial for the case, not justice for the dead. We don’t want condolences. We want the officers’ names, a public courtroom, and an independent autopsy. The men who ran the old dungeons are gone. The dungeons are still full. The new Syria isn’t judged by its statements, it’s judged by whether Mohammad (or any other detainee) can die in a police cell and anyone answers for it.

Todo el casamiento estuvo relacionado con una referencia peculiar de la carrera futbolística del delantero: el número siete. El reciente terremoto de magnitud 7,7 en Indonesia y el de 7,4 registrado en Colombia, ocurridos en menos de una semana, evidenció una vez más la intensidad y la frecuencia de los fenómenos extremos que caracterizan a este extenso anillo tectónico. Este último terremoto, que tuvo epicentro en San José del Palmar en el departamento del Chocó y una profundidad de 107 kilómetros, dejó casi 300 muertos, miles de heridos y provocó el derrumbe de edificios en ciudades como Cali, Pereira y Manizales, según datos del Servicio Geológico de Estados Unidos (USGS). 🔗infob.ae/3TWhims

Weekend Ukraine map thread for Sunday 15th August 2026 A focus on the western Zaporizhia direction today, principally because Russian infiltrators have been spotted in Orikhiv. Initially, these were suspected to be the group that appeared in July and early August. However, @Playfra0 believes there may be rather more to it than that, so we're going to give the area some attention. Further east, Russian forces are attempting to push west of Huliapilske towards Omel'nyk. We're not expecting large movements any time soon, but it is worth noting. This is something Ukraine will need to deal with over the coming months before it grows into one of those irritating little problems which everyone ignores until it has acquired artillery. The map also now reflects the small area Ukraine recovered earlier this year from the grey zone near Stepnohirsk. Mostly just for visual clarity. Neither side currently appears capable of concentrating sufficient forces to achieve anything particularly useful here, so expect the usual combination of shelling, probing, infiltration and pretend footage until something fundamental changes. Meanwhile, the Russian rear continues to receive long range strikes. An FP-5 missile strike devastated the Progress factory in Samara, involved in the Soyuz programme and Rassvet satellites. UK long-range drones subsequently paid a visit to the largest Wildberries hub at Koledino last night, along with a logistics hub in Domodedovo, formerly belonging to B.I. Logistics - a company which, @kromark notes, rather charmingly hosted radioactive substances in the past (probably unrelated). The Kombinat Kamensky rocket fuel facility was also struck. EL MENSAJE DE JAVIER MILEI SOBRE EL CASO DE FACUNDO MOYANO Y SU PAREJA: “EXPERTO EN PAROS” El presidente Javier Milei se burló este domingo de Facundo Moyano con un meme en Instagram después del episodio que involucró al exdiputado y a su pareja, Candela Arizaga, en el barrio porteño de Belgrano. La publicación retomó la explicación que el dirigente dio sobre lo ocurrido y volvió a poner en circulación un caso que ya había escalado a la agenda política y judicial. La imagen que compartió Milei incluyó la frase “Al final Moyanito terminó siendo un experto en paros como el padre”, una alusión directa a Facundo Moyano y a Hugo Moyano, jefe del sindicato de Camioneros y figura del sindicalismo argentino. El posteo apareció después de varios días de repercusión pública por la causa abierta tras la madrugada del 4 de agosto. El hecho al que aludió el Presidente ocurrió cuando Arizaga salió del departamento de Moyano, ubicado sobre la avenida del Libertador al 5400, y fue vista corriendo semidesnuda por la calle. La secuencia derivó en la intervención de la Policía de la Ciudad, en el traslado de la joven al Hospital Pirovano y en la demora del dirigente sindical. 🔗infob.ae/4x4aUYM

CODAZOS Y GOLPES EN LA CARA: EL IMPACTANTE NOCAUT DEL ARGENTINO ESTEBAN RIBOVICS A UNA LEYENDA DE LA UFC En la velada de UFC 330 en Filadelfia, un argentino fue gran protagonista. Esteban Ribovics venció a Edson Barboza por nocaut técnico en un combate de la categoría peso ligero. Tras una secuencia de golpes, el árbitro detuvo la lucha en el segundo asalto y le dio la victoria al Gringo. Después del combate, la leyenda brasileña de las artes marciales mixtas anunció su retiro y dejó sus guantes en el centro del octágono. Ribovics, nacido en Tartagal, marcó el ritmo de la pelea desde el inicio. Abrió la ceja derecha de Barboza con fuertes golpes y estuvo cerca de terminarlo al cierre del primer round. En el segundo, mantuvo el control hasta que el árbitro dio por finalizado el combate y decretó el nocaut técnico luego de una serie de dos codazos y otros golpes de puño a la cara de su rival. Con este resultado, el argentino suma cinco triunfos en ocho peleas dentro de la UFC. 🔗infob.ae/4wB0Wxd

GEORGINA RODRÍGUEZ SE CASÓ CON CRISTIANO RONALDO SIN VESTIDO Y EN EL SALÓN DE SU CASA: “CASTILLOS TENEMOS AL ALCANCE DE LA MANO, ALGO ÍNTIMO ES MÁS INUSUAL” | Por Alejandro Burrueco Como ya todo el mundo sabe, Cristiano Ronaldo y Georgina Rodríguez se casaron en una ceremonia íntima celebrada el 11 de agosto en Cascais, la misma fecha en la que se conocieron hace 10 años en una tienda Gucci de Madrid. Sin embargo, ahora un reportaje con Vogue ha destapado que la boda fue en su propia casa, con la intención de convertir el aniversario en un acto familiar y privado lejos de los rumores sobre una gran boda ostentosa y repleta de famosos. Según han narrado al citado medio, la boda ha tenido lugar en el salón de su vivienda portuguesa, ya que que querían una celebración doméstica con sus hijos como protagonistas. Al día siguiente del enlace, Rodríguez aseguró que todo fue “exactamente” como lo había imaginado y que no pudo contener las lágrimas. Durante semanas circularon en internet especulaciones sobre la fecha del enlace, el lugar y una lista de invitados repleta de celebridades. La realidad ha sido la contraria: no hubo gran fiesta pública ni despliegue social, sino una ceremonia reducida que la pareja llevaba tiempo planeando y que después ha dado pie a las primeras imágenes oficiales, que distan mucho de lo esperado, puesto que Georgina Rodríguez ni siquiera llevó un típico vestido. 🔗infob.ae/3UkD3MJ

We no longer have a carrier presence in the Pacific… The debate about the food aboard the Lincoln and now the George Washington is largely a red herring. Arguing about food substitutes an emotional argument for a stark practical one. The real issue is how the war on Iran is burning through equipment and people. I.e., now the Lincoln, along with the Ford, will most certainly undergo maintenance for an extended period because of the length of their deployments in support of the war in Iran. Those deployments will also hurt retention (this was a major issue during the Iraq War in particular; remember stop loss?) And the question is: for what? It’s not like they were chasing the Imperial Japanese Navy across the Pacific following an attack like Pearl Harbor. Now the Administration, despite all the warnings about Taiwan and a China-focused National Security Strategy, is moving our only carrier out of the Pacific. This is a major strategic signal, coming on the heels of news that we’ve burned through other major capabilities such as interceptors, radars, stand-off munitions, and a large chunk of the MQ-9 fleet, among other things. It is clear that the Iran war is not only detrimental to US national security, but a potential strategic blunder worse than Iraq if we don’t cut bait; and this is the conversation pro-war types want to avoid at all costs. apnews.com/article/aircraft-…

VIDEO | Panjim, Goa: Hyderabad Black Hawks U21 were crowned champions of the inaugural volleyball Guardians Trophy after defeating hosts Goa Guardians U21 3-1 in the final here on Sunday, with captain Deepak attributing the win to the team’s strong cohesion and combination. Hyderabad, who had beaten Ahmedabad Defenders U21 in straight sets in the semifinals made a dominant start to the title clash, winning the opening set 16-7. Goa, backed by the home crowd, fought back to take the second set 15-11, but Hyderabad regained the advantage by edging a closely contested third set 16-14. The Black Hawks then sealed the title with a 15-8 win in the fourth set. "It feels very good to win. Our team's combination was very good today, and that is why we were able to win," Deepak told PTI after the victory. Hyderabad's Sarthak was the standout performer of the tournament, taking home the MVP, Best Server, and Best Opposite awards. Deepak was named Best Attacker, while Goa players Suraj, Arjun, and Yogesh won the Best Blocker, Best Setter, and Best Libero awards, respectively. MORIA CASÁN CUMPLE 80: LOS EMOTIVOS MENSAJES DE LOS FAMOSOS A LA ICÓNICA DIVA | Por Martina Cortés Hay aniversarios que no son solo una fecha: son un verdadero acontecimiento nacional. Este 16 de agosto, Moria Casán cumple 80 años y la Argentina entera celebra a una de las mujeres más magnéticas, desafiantes y entrañables de su historia popular. Ícono absoluto de la cultura, pionera, musa y creadora de frases eternas, la exvedette, actriz y conductora no solo resiste el paso del tiempo, sino que lo transforma en leyenda. En medio del furor por la serie que recorre su vida y con la llegada de un nuevo año, el afecto de sus colegas y amigos desborda las redes en homenajes que mezclan gratitud, admiración y una alegría profundamente compartida. Entre los primeros mensajes que resonaron estuvo el de Nora Cárpena, quien compartió varias fotos junto a Moria y un mensaje cargado de nostalgia: “Por tantas horas de camarines compartidas. BENJAMÍN VICUÑA HABLÓ DEL VÍNCULO CON SUS HIJOS MENORES A PESAR DE LA DISTANCIA: “ESO NO ME LO PUEDE ROBAR NADIE” | Por Andrea Mazzei La noche del sábado en PH, Podemos Hablar, el ciclo conducido por Andy Kusnetzoff, tuvo un momento de profunda sinceridad cuando Benjamín Vicuña compartió con el público y el resto de los invitados sus sentimientos respecto a la distancia que lo separa de sus hijos menores, Magnolia y Amancio. Desde que su expareja, la China Suárez, emprendió una nueva vida en Turquía junto a Mauro Icardi, el actor chileno enfrenta la realidad de tener a sus hijos a más de 14 mil kilómetros. “Evidentemente el día a día es fundamental. Me ha pasado en momentos de mi vida que he trabajado un montón, me fui a Chile, Argentina, España, México, Colombia, y obviamente que eso es el trabajo que no siempre justifica todo”, expresó Vicuña, dejando en claro que ningún éxito profesional compensa la ausencia diaria en la vida de los hijos. Aunque en las últimas semanas Magnolia y Amancio volvieron a la Argentina, permitiendo un reencuentro más fluido, la situación deja huellas. Vicuña no oculta el dolor ni la incomodidad que provoca tener que adaptarse a una paternidad que se construye a la distancia. “Con respecto a mi situación hoy, que mis hijos pueden estar a 14 mil kilómetros, yo estoy muy seguro del vínculo que tengo con ellos, eso no me lo puede robar nadie. El amor. Y trato de atravesar las circunstancias que nos adversas, porque claramente no es cómodo, ni es lindo, ni es bueno ni es justo pero intento mantener un contacto a diario”, relató el actor. 🔗infob.ae/4zqpDz2

UNA CAMIONETA CHOCÓ CONTRA UN AUTO Y VOLCÓ EN EL BARRIO PORTEÑO DE ALMAGRO: TIENE 10 MULTAS POR EXCESO DE VELOCIDAD Una camioneta marca Kangoo chocó este domingo contra un automóvil y, como consecuencia de ese impacto, el utilitario terminó volcado sobre la calle. El incidente ocurrió en la esquina formada por la avenida Rivadavia y la calle Yapeyú, en el barrio porteño de Almagro. El vehículo involucrado tiene más de diez infracciones registradas. Según el parte oficial del Sistema de Atención Médica de Emergencias (SAME), en la Kangoo viajaban un hombre de 31 años y una mujer de 36 años. Ambos salieron del vehículo sin requerir asistencia de terceros y no presentaron lesiones visibles, por lo que firmaron la negativa de traslado al hospital. Data Patterns isn't stopping at India either, it's pitching Hawk-I-2700 to every other country still flying Su-30s with old Russian radars, that's a real export shot most people are missing

🇮🇳 India now has two rival radars racing for the same job, and that's actually a good problem to have. Both are built to replace the ageing Russian Bars radar on the Su-30MKI. DRDO's Virupaksha carries around 2,400 GaN modules and just hit its first power-on milestone in February. Private firm Data Patterns countered with the Hawk-I-2700, packing up to 2,700 modules and a longer claimed range. Here's why GaN matters so much. It runs cooler and pushes more power than the older Gallium Arsenide tech, which means longer range, sharper tracking, and better resistance to jamming. The IAF now gets to pick the better system, government-built or private-built, instead of settling for whatever's available.

Vaccines protect people at every stage of life: from a child’s first days through adulthood and beyond. In early childhood, immune systems are still developing, leaving young children more vulnerable to serious illness. That’s why most routine vaccines are given in the first two years of life, offering protection when it matters most. As children grow into their teenage years, booster doses help keep that protection strong and respond to new and emerging health risks. During pregnancy, vaccination plays a crucial role in protecting both parent and baby. Recommended vaccines help pass protective antibodies to babies before birth, giving them a safer start in life. In adulthood and older age, the immune system naturally becomes less robust. Vaccines help reduce the risk of severe illness and hospitalization, helping people stay healthy and live longer. Vaccination is about care, prevention and giving every generation the chance to learn, grow and thrive. #VaccinesWork Video
