“ME SEPARÉ DE QUIEN AMABA Y TRES AÑOS DESPUÉS ME DI CUENTA DE QUE ERA POR UNA RAZÓN DISTINTA DE LA QUE CREÍA” | Por Juan Tonelli Me quedaban nueve días para decidir qué hacer con esas fotos antes de que el teléfono las borrara definitivamente. Habían pasado casi tres años desde que nos separamos y ahí estaba yo, recorriendo la carpeta de eliminados y recuperando algunas de las imágenes que tres semanas antes había decidido borrar, convencida de que ese gesto podía ayudarme a terminar de soltarlo. Ahora no estaba tan segura. No sabía si estaba salvando recuerdos que formaban parte de mi vida o si, detrás de ese argumento razonable, seguía escondida la fantasía de que algún día él volviera. Dicen que las fotos son lo último que se tira cuando uno ordena una casa y decide desprenderse de las cosas que ya no necesita. Quizás sea porque una foto nunca es solamente una foto, sino una puerta que se abre hacia una persona, una época o una versión de nosotros mismos que ya no existe. Uno mira una imagen tomada diez años atrás y no ve apenas dos personas sonriendo frente a una cámara: recuerda lo que estaba pasando ese día, lo que sentía, aquello que todavía no había sucedido y, sobre todo, la felicidad que en ese momento parecía tan natural que ni siquiera imaginábamos que alguna vez podría terminarse. Durante casi tres años me había negado a borrar las fotos que tenía con él con un argumento que me parecía bastante sensato. Tampoco había eliminado las imágenes de relaciones anteriores porque esas personas, aunque ya no estuvieran en mi vida, formaban parte de mi historia y no veía ningún sentido en fingir que nunca habían existido. Hasta que un día mi psicóloga me dijo algo que me dolió bastante más de lo que estaba dispuesta a reconocer. 🔗infob.ae/4ibCw9J

EN JULIO SE REGISTRÓ UN RÉCORD DE IMPORTACIÓN DE NEUMÁTICOS: CUÁNTOS ENTRARON AL MERCADO Y QUIÉNES LIDERAN EL RANKING | Por Diego Zorrero Desde que el 18 de febrero se cerraron las puertas de FATE, la única fábrica argentina de neumáticos de capitales nacionales en el mercado, la estadística de importación de neumáticos se convirtió en un tema de mayor interés. La suma de la apertura irrestricta de las importaciones, la eliminación del precio de referencia que protegía a la industria nacional, y la baja progresiva de arancel de importación para ir del 35% al 16% actual, motivaron la decisión irrevocable de Javier Madanes Quintanilla de finalizar una historia familiar de producción argentina de neumáticos que perduró 85 años en el mercado. Sin embargo, esa misma situación fue la que permitió que los usuarios tengan disponibilidad de productos, mayor oferta y menores precios de lo que había en diciembre de 2023. En julio de 2026, en la categoría de autos y camionetas, se marcó un nuevo récord de importaciones con 762.548 unidades. La mejor marca anterior había sido mayo de 2025 con 737.341 unidades. 🔗infob.ae/45zRGOK

UNO POR UNO, TODOS LOS AMORES DE MORIA: PASIONES Y DOLORES DE UNA DIVA POPULAR | Por Sol de María Moria Casán tuvo bodas en tres continentes, romances con hombres décadas más jóvenes, separaciones con escándalo televisivo y al menos una historia que se niega a revelar hasta hoy. La vida sentimental de Ana María Casanova —su nombre real— es tan extensa y variada como su trayectoria artística, y ella misma la reconstruyó en distintas entrevistas a lo largo de los años sin demasiados filtros. Maridos, amantes, vínculos clandestinos y un amor que llegó a los 80 años: el historial de la One es un recorrido por más de cinco décadas de pasiones públicas y privadas. Antes de que su carrera despegara del todo, hubo un primer amor de adolescencia: un hombre de apellido Mayorano del que ella misma admitió en una emisión de Secretos Verdaderos que pasó prácticamente inadvertido. No dejó huella pública ni declaraciones de peso, pero forma parte del inicio de una historia sentimental que con los años se volvería cada vez más expuesta. El primero en dejar una marca profunda —y dolorosa— fue Juan Carlos Bojanich, un fabricante de ropa de origen yugoslavo con quien se casó cuando ella daba sus primeros pasos como vedette. La relación duró apenas tres meses y terminó de la peor manera. Años después, Moria reveló públicamente que Bojanich la había golpeado durante el vínculo. “Me golpeó pero por suerte pude reaccionar y me elegí. Me separé y se solucionó todo”, declaró la actriz, en el programa Secretos Verdaderos de América. La confesión derivó en una demanda judicial del empresario contra ella, que se extendió durante años hasta que en 2010 la Justicia argentina desestimó la acción y consideró sus declaraciones amparadas por la libertad de expresión. 🔗infob.ae/4gzwJtp

ফুটবল ক্যারিয়ারের শেষের ইঙ্গিত দিলেন পর্তুগিজ সুপারস্টার ক্রিস্টিয়ানো রোনালদো। বয়সের সঙ্গে সঙ্গে ক্যারিয়ারের শেষ প্রান্তে এসে দাঁড়ানো পর্তুগিজ মহাতারকা জানিয়েছেন, চলতি বছরই হতে পারে ফুটবলে তার শেষ বছর। রোনালদো বলেন, ‘সম্ভবত এটাই হবে আমার ফুটবলে শেষ বছর… আমি এক অসাধারণ কীর্তি রেখে যেতে চাই।’ দীর্ঘ ক্যারিয়ারে ব্যক্তিগত ও দলীয় অসংখ্য সাফল্য পেয়েছেন রোনালদো। ইউরোপের শীর্ষ ক্লাবগুলোর হয়ে জিতেছেন একের পর এক শিরোপা, ব্যক্তিগতভাবে পেয়েছেন বিশ্বের অন্যতম সেরা ফুটবলারের স্বীকৃতি। পর্তুগালের হয়েও গড়েছেন ইতিহাস। #football #SportsNews #Sports #somoytv

অস্ট্রেলিয়ার মাটিতে টেস্ট খেলাটাই যেন অনেক কিছু। আর সেখানে জয় পাওয়াটা তো আরও বেশি কিছু। ডারউইনে বিশ্বের অন্যতম শক্তিশালী এই দলটাকেই টেনে হিঁচড়ে মাটিতে নামিয়ে আনলো বাংলাদেশ। তাদের দম্ভ চূর্ণ করে মাত্র চতুর্থ দিনেই ৯ উইকেটের জয়ে ইতিহাসের পাতায় নিজেদের নামটা খোদাই করে রাখলেন লাল-সবুজের প্রতিনিধিরা। এমন ইতিহাস গড়া জয়ে রেকর্ড বইয়েও পরিবর্তন এসেছে বেশ। টেস্টে বাংলাদেশের চেয়ে কম ম্যাচ খেলে অস্ট্রেলিয়ায় প্রথম জয় পেয়েছে মাত্র একটি দল। অস্ট্রেলিয়ায় তাদেরকে দ্বিতীয় ম্যাচেই হারিয়েছিল ইংল্যান্ড। সেটি ছিল ইতিহাসের দ্বিতীয় টেস্টও। আর বাংলাদেশ অস্ট্রেলিয়ার মাটিতে জয় পেলো মাত্র তৃতীয় টেস্টেই। #cricket #cricketnews #Sports #somoytv

NITI Aayog has released the report “Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub,” presenting a roadmap to strengthen India’s manufacturing ecosystem and advance the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. The study assesses 62 manufacturing sectors and identifies 12 high-potential sectors where India can build scale, enhance competitiveness, create quality employment, and deepen integration with global value chains. The analysis draws on sectoral assessment, international benchmarking, and industry consultations. The identified sectors are: Automobiles, Chemicals, Capital Goods, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, Defence & Drones, Food Processing, Textiles, Steel, Leather & Footwear, Telecom Equipment, and Solar PV Manufacturing. Volume I focuses on Chemicals, Textiles, Telecom & Network Equipment, and Solar PV Manufacturing, and provides sector-specific pathways to strengthen value addition, technology, and global competitiveness. 📖 Read the report: niti.gov.in/sites/default/fi… #GlobalManufacturingHub #ViksitBharat2047 @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

बांग्लादेश ने ऑस्ट्रेलियाई टीम का घमंड तोड़ते हुए पहले टेस्ट में 9 विकेट से शानदार जीत दर्ज कर इतिहास रच दिया. डार्विन में खेले गए टेस्ट को हारकर पैट कमिंस की अगुवाई वाली टीम दो मैचों की सीरीज में 0-1 से पिछड़ गई है. दूसरा टेस्ट शनिवार (22 अगस्त) से मकाय में खेला जाएगा. शर्मनाक हार के बाद ऑस्ट्रेलिया प्लेइंग इलेवन में कुछ बड़े बदलाव कर सकती है. 32 साल के स्टार बल्लेबाज मार्नस लाबुशेन का खराब फॉर्म टीम मैनेजमेंट के लिए सबसे बड़ी सिरदर्दी साबित हो रही है. बांग्लादेश के खिलाफ टेस्ट में लाबुशेन दोनों पारियों में फेल हो गए. उन्होंने पहली इनिंग में एक और दूसरी पारी में 31 रन बनाए. ऐसा नहीं है कि मार्नस लाबुशेन सिर्फ इसी मैच में फ्लॉप हुए हैं. वो लंबे समय से खराब फॉर्म से गुजर रहे हैं, लेकिन टीम की जीत में उनकी नाकामी छिप जा रही थी. बांग्लादेश के खिलाफ मिली शर्मनाक हार के बाद प्लेइंग इलेवन में मार्नस लाबुशेन की जगह पर सवाल उठने लगे हैं. 42 पारियों से नहीं जड़ा शतक ऑस्ट्रेलिया जैसी टीम में 3-4 पारियों में फ्लॉप होने के बाद ही बल्लेबाजों पर सवाल उठने लगते हैं, लेकिन मार्नस लाबुशेन के साथ ऐसा नहीं हुआ. लगातार फेल होने के बावजूद उन्हें मौके मिलते रहे. आपको ये जानकर झटका लगेगा कि दाएं हाथ के बल्लेबाज ने टेस्ट में आखिरी शतक 2023 में लगाया था. उसके बाद से वो 42 पारियां खेल चुके हैं, लेकिन 100 रन का आंकड़ा क्रॉस नहीं किया है. इस दौरान उनका औसत 25.23 का रहा है. मार्नस लाबुशेन का हाल पाकिस्तान के स्टार बल्लेबाज और कप्तान बाबर आजम जैसा हो गया है. दोनों एक समय पर शानदार फॉर्म में चल रहे थे, लेकिन पिछले कुछ सालों से शतक का सूखा पड़ गया है. बता दें कि बाबर आजम का टेस्ट में शतक का इंतजार लाबुशेन से भी ज्यादा समय से चल रहा है. बाबर ने टेस्ट में आखिरी सेंचुरी 2022 में ठोकी थी. दूसरे टेस्ट से बाहर हो सकते हैं ये 2 बल्लेबाज पहला टेस्ट हारने के बाद ऑस्ट्रेलियाई टीम दूसरे मैच में शानदार वापसी करना चाहेगी. टीम की फजीहत तो हो ही रही है, कमिंस एंड कंपनी किसी कीमत पर बांग्लादेश से सीरीज हारने का दर्द नहीं सहना चाहेगी. 22 अगस्त से होने वाले दूसरे टेस्ट में प्लेइंग इलेवन में 2 बदलाव हो सकते हैं. मार्नस लाबुशेन के अलावा ओपनर जेक वेदरल्ड को भी बाहर का रास्ता दिखाया जा सकता है. बाएं हाथ के ओपनर ने अभी तक 6 टेस्ट की 12 पारियों में 20.36 की साधारण औसत से सिर्फ 224 रन बना सके हैं. उनके जल्दी आउट होने से टीम को अच्छी शुरुआत नहीं मिल पा रही है. #MarnusLabuschagne #Australia #AusVsBan #Cricket केरलम में तो कांग्रेस सरकार ने हदें पार करते हुए स्वतंत्रता दिवस समारोह से ‘वंदे मातरम्’ को पूरी तरह हटा दिया। कट्टरपंथियों के सामने घुटने टेकना अब कांग्रेस की स्थायी नीति बन चुकी है। तुष्टिकरण की गंदी राजनीति के लिए उन्होंने उन हजारों स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों का अपमान किया है, जिन्होंने इसी गीत को अपने होठों पर सजाकर देश के लिए बलिदान दिया था। यह केवल एक गीत रोकने की घटना नहीं, बल्कि उस परिवारवादी अहंकार की निशानी है, जिसके तहत कांग्रेस को भारत की हर उस चीज़ से चिढ़ है, जिस पर इस राष्ट्र को गर्व है।

एक बार फिर साबित हो गया कि आज़ादी के आठ दशक बाद भी कांग्रेस का ‘वंदे मातरम्’ के प्रति कोई सम्मान नहीं है। कांग्रेस मुख्यालय में जब राष्ट्रगीत गाया जा रहा था, तब सोनिया गांधी जी ने उसे रोकने का इशारा किया। यह कोई संयोग नहीं, बल्कि कांग्रेस की विकृत सोच का कड़वा सच है। जो पार्टी ‘भारत माता’ के इस पावन गीत से असहज हो जाती है, वह भारतीयता से कितनी जुड़ी है, यह देश की जनता अच्छी तरह समझ चुकी है।

PRESS RELEASE Family Expresses Gratitude To All Who Participated in Buhari’s Burial and Prayers The most senior member of the Buhari family, the family of the late President, Muhammadu Buhari, Malam Mamman Daura has, on behalf of the family expressed gratitude to President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and his wife, the First Lady, Senator Remi Tinubu for their role and that of Government of the Federation before, and after the passing of the former president. “It is truly comforting to receive such support from the President and the Vice President, Kashim Shettima, who went to the United Kingdom, and here in Daura, for the days he and the ministers during the mourning period. These have instilled confidence in all of us to face this loss with courage. “We are deeply grateful to the President on his thoughtful gestures in declaring a public holiday and renaming the University of Maiduguri after Buhari. “Our gratitude also goes to leaders of the various countries around the globe who either came in person, sent representatives, sent letters, or placed personal telephone calls to commiserate with us. Of special note were those of the King of England, King Charles III, the Secretary General of the United Nations, the Deputy Secretary General, Amina Mohammed, the Chairman of the African Union, and that of the Committee of Heads of State and Government of ECOWAS countries, and our former Head of State, Abdulsalami Abubakar. “Muhammadu Buhari’s demise is an irreparable loss and its pain is beyond words, but the general reaction and kind expressions give us the strength to cope with the loss of our esteemed family member and former leader of the country. “The family is equally grateful to Vice President Kashim Shettima in his own person and his wife, and to all state governors, especially those of Katsina, the host governor Dr Dikko Umar Radda; Professor Babagana Umara Zulum of Borno State and all those who visited us in the UK and Daura from Adamawa, Kano, Kwara, Lagos, Kaduna, Imo, Nasarawa, Bauchi, Sokoto, Kebbi as well as the several former governors, including Dr Peter Obi for their compassionate words of condolence. Your empathy has touched our hearts deeply, and we are truly grateful for your kindness. "We express our deep appreciations to former Vice Presidents Atiku Abubakar, Architect Namadi Sambo, Professor Yemi Osinbajo, and Ambassador Babagana Kingibe as well as to the President of Senate, Godswill Akpabio, the Speaker, House of Representatives, Honorable Tajuddeen Abbas, Deputy Senate President Barau Jibrin and the other leaders and members of the National and State Assemblies. “We do sincerely thank the Secretary to the Government of the Federation, SGF, Senator George Akume and his predecessor in office, Boss Mustapha, the current Chief of Staff, Honorable Femi Gbajabiamila and his predecessor, Professor Ibrahim Gambari, former and serving members of the cabinet in both administrations for their activities in these events and their comforting words. “We are very pleased with the amazing gestures of our traditional leaders, notably the Sultan of Sokoto, the Shehu of Borno, the Emir of Gwandu and the host emirs of Katsina and Daura, as well as the various emirs and chiefs from all over Nigeria and the neighboring countries who came in person or sent representatives. “We have been honored by the large turnout of religious leaders, Islamic, Christian and of other faiths, community leaders, women, youth and politicians of various leanings whose surge in Daura was both challenging and reassuring. “The family in Daura is also thanking past and serving security and intelligence, police and military leaders, permanent secretaries, and the rank and file civil servants, community groups and associations, civil society, and the media of communications. 1/2

A Spanish F-18 operating under NATO air-policing authorities shot down a drone that breached Romanian airspace early Sunday, according to Romania’s Defense Ministry. Romanian radars detected the drone entering from neighboring Moldova, about 15 miles north of Galați. The F-18 established radar contact and received authorization to engage, bringing the drone down at 05:01 local time. Debris reportedly fell in an uninhabited area. Romania says this is the fourth drone it has shot down this year. The country has experienced repeated Russian drone incursions during the war in Ukraine, including three Russian drones shot down by Romanian F-16s in July.

The passing of Asish Banerjee has left me deeply disturbed. He spent much of his life teaching and serving society with dedication, always known for his humble nature and close bond with the people of Rampurhat and Birbhum. What makes this tragedy even more painful is the immense mental and emotional strain he appears to have endured in his final days. Shah Mohammad Mehrabi, a member of the Board of Trustees of the Fund for the Afghan People, tells TOLOnews that the fund has earned $661 million in profits since its establishment. According to him, The Afghanistan Fund assets are now growing to $4.19 billion as of July 31, 2026. Mehrabi added that the fund’s assets are not intended to provide humanitarian assistance or cover government expenditures, but rather to preserve Afghanistan’s foreign exchange reserves. He added that the fund’s financial statements are independently audited each year by the international auditing firms that provides greater transparency and assurance regarding how the fund’s assets are managed. #TOLOnews_English

The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) in Afghanistan has said that from the beginning of this year through August, 92,000 people across the country have been affected by natural disasters, while 97 others have died. According to OCHA’s latest report, 331 people have been injured across 202 districts, more than 10,000 homes have been damaged, and over 2,000 others have been destroyed. OCHA added that Afghanistan’s eastern provinces have suffered the greatest losses from natural disasters this year. Expressing concern over reduced funding from international donors, the UN office said that of the estimated $1.7 billion needed for 2026, only $447 million, or 26 percent of the total, has been received. #TOLOnews_English

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has said that his country has no obstacles to issuing visas to Afghan applicants and that the Foreign Ministry is ready to cooperate in this regard. Speaking at a meeting officials of Khorasan Razavi province, he said that issues concerning border provinces can be better resolved at the regional level and with Afghanistan’s border provinces, without the need for negotiations between Kabul and Tehran. Referring to Afghanistan, Pakistan, and Turkmenistan, Araghchi said that Iran’s neighboring countries are among the country’s most important economic opportunities amid sanctions. Araghchi also said that Khorasan Razavi province has the authority to expand trade relations and cross-border travel with neighboring countries. #TOLOnews_English

According to the report, thousands of Afghans were evacuated to European countries following the collapse of the republican government in August 2021, particularly those who had worked with foreign organizations. The growing influence of right-wing parties in Europe could affect Afghan refugees in several ways. Such parties generally favor restricting immigration, tightening asylum requirements, and returning those who do not have a legal basis to remain. Wildberries attack stats show 21 logistics sites hit with attacks, fires or evacuations from July 18 to August 16. The company has 209+ facilities totaling 5.6 million square meters, but 11 major complexes covering 1.38 million square meters were down by August 5th, nearly a quarter of all warehouse space. Not all 21 sites were directly hit, some just evacuated. Wildberries says the network keeps running by redirecting cargo, but each major facility knocked out strains the rest and complicates operations across Russia. WarTranslated (@wartranslated) Ukrainian drone attacks on Wildberries warehouses may have caused 800 billion rubles in damage, about $10 billion, Russian Forbes reports. Over 20 logistics centers were hit, at least 14 burned down. More than 400,000 sellers face losses, some lost up to 95% of their goods. 80th Independence Day Celebrations at JCP Attari Parade Arena The 80th Independence Day celebrations at Attari, Amritsar, were held with great fervour and patriotic spirit, with DG BSF Shri Praveen Kumar, IPS, as the Chief Guest. The celebrations commenced with the inauguration of a giant LED screen displaying the image of Mahatma Gandhi, the Father of the Nation, adding a solemn and inspiring dimension to the occasion. A vibrant tapestry of India’s diversity and unity unfolded through cultural programmes representing different regions of the country. The performances beautifully showcased India’s rich cultural heritage and the spirit of Ek Bharat, Shreshtha Bharat. Nearly 60,000 spectators from different parts of the country filled the JCP stadium and the campus, transforming the venue into a sea of patriotism, enthusiasm and national pride. BSF personnel from various training institutions showcased their exceptional skills through special sporting events and performances, reflecting their discipline, determination and physical prowess. The BSF Motorcycle Daredevil Team Janbaz and Seema Bhavani and Canine Squad presented a meticulously orchestrated display of precision, discipline and fearless skill, leaving the audience spellbound. The jubilant parade further raised the tempo and infused the gathering with unmatched josh, creating an electrifying atmosphere befitting the celebration of 80 years of India’s Independence. The Director General appreciated the outstanding performances by all the participating teams and applauded the organisers for conducting such a grand and spectacular show, which brought together thousands of citizens in a celebration of India’s unity, diversity and indomitable spirit. 14-15 August 2026 DG BSF Reviews Operational Preparedness in Amritsar Sector DG BSF Shri Praveen Kumar, IPS reviewed the operational preparedness of Amritsar Sector, Punjab Frontier, visiting forward locations and assessing the progress of the new design border fence. During his visit, DG BSF inaugurated total 12 barracks for mahila prahari. The Mahila Prahari Barrack at Border out Post Havelian was inaugurated in physical mode, while 11 other Mahila Prahari barracks at different BOPs in Gurdaspur, Firozpur and Abohar Sectors of Punjab Frontier were inaugurated virtually on 14th August. Interacting with troops during the Prahari Sammelan, DG BSF appreciated their dedication and hard work and exhorted them to continuously hone their skills to meet evolving border security challenges, particularly the use of drones by anti-national elements. He assured them of all support for their welfare and felicitated outstanding performers with the commendation roll

Екстрені служби працюють на місцях ранкових та нічних російських ударів. У Києві оперативно ліквідували пожежі, зараз тривають аварійні роботи. У місті та області росіяни поранили шістьох людей. Під ударами балістикою також були Кременчук і Кривий Ріг. Всюди, де росіяни дотягуються своєю балістикою, вони бʼють по цивільній інфраструктурі. У Кривому Розі двоє загиблих і ще 14 людей постраждали. Є загибла людина в Сумах. Мої співчуття рідним та близьким. Від ранку продовжується тривога у багатьох регіонах: росіяни випустили нову хвилю дронів. Лише протягом цього тижня 13 областей були під ударами. Ворог випустив по наших містах і громадах понад 1550 ударних дронів, майже 1560 авіабомб та 62 ракети. Серед них більшість – балістика різних типів. Вдячний усім службам – підрозділам ДСНС, поліції, медикам, – які першими прибувають на місця атак, допомагають людям, швидко спрацьовують на порятунок і відновлення життя. Дуже важливо, щоб ця самовідданість наших людей доповнювалася новими кроками партнерів для захисту неба. Коли північнокорейська балістика руйнує інфраструктуру і забирає життя тут, у Європі, не можна дозволити, щоб європейські перехоплювачі просто лежали на складах. Захист життя потрібен. Росію потрібно зупинити. Нові пакети – це буквально врятовані життя і захищена інфраструктура кожен день. Дякую кожному партнеру, який із цим допомагає.

He won both sets 3-1 and finished the tournament without losing a single match. The 35-year-old revealed that his conservative approach was a deliberate strategy, shaped partly by the demanding 10-minute, no-increment format and partly by concerns over his physical condition during the tournament. "I started watching the Mourinho documentary on Netflix the other day and they were talking about the first season that they were just winning 1-0 every match and I was thinking, well, that sounds pretty nice, doesn’t it?" Trump Gives Green Light to Saudi Nuclear Program The Donald Trump administration has finalized the draft of a bilateral nuclear agreement that authorizes Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium on its own territory. Although the negotiating teams have completed the terms, the document still awaits Trump’s final signature and approval by the U.S. Congress. This framework breaks with the region’s long-standing non-proliferation rules. Unlike the deal with the United Arab Emirates, which permanently renounced uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing while accepting strict IAEA inspections, the agreement with the Saudis does not require Riyadh to adopt the Agency’s inspection regime. Oversight will be limited to a bilateral pact between the United States and Saudi Arabia. This reinforces what Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has already said openly: if Iran gets a nuclear weapon, Saudi Arabia will want one too. It sounds like a clear signal that Riyadh believes Tehran already has, or is very close to having, the bomb, which explains the intense pressure they are putting on Washington. The situation puts the U.S. in a complicated position. Saudi Arabia’s ballistic missile program is developed in partnership with China, complete with technology transfers. If the Americans don’t give in now, the Saudis have plenty of money to look for other partners. This is not just about civilian nuclear energy. For that, it would be enough to buy reactors and import ready-made fuel. What Riyadh really wants is to master the full nuclear fuel cycle, especially domestic uranium enrichment. With this infrastructure, Saudi Arabia is building a nuclear latency capability: it will control the core technology needed to develop a weapon in relatively short order if pushed by an existential threat. Imphal, Manipur: On gymnast Ariha Pangambam winning gold at the Senior Individual Women's Asian Aerobic Gymnastics Championships, her father, Pangambam Akhelo, says, "We watched the performance on television. Despite my daughter’s participation, we felt anxious and restless throughout the broadcast. Training is challenging due to the frequent imposition of bandhs and the chaotic situation in Manipur. These disruptions have significantly affected her practice schedule. Despite curfew hours, we attempted to visit the gymnasium in the early morning when it was open." He adds, "The current coach, Yumnam Ranjan, a retired ex-serviceman who dedicated his work at Khuman Lampak and trained our daughter Ariha, is also an approved International Judge of the Gymnastics Federation of India (GFI) and the International Gymnastics Federation. I aspire for my daughter to achieve international success and become a champion in the World Championships, Olympics, and World Games." So does a nation’s right to grow and shape its own future. That is why burning books has always meant far more than destroying merchandise. I have waived my royalties for the next year to help support my publisher. I encourage you to buy Ukrainian books—as a gesture of solidarity with Ukrainians fighting, among other things, for the right to read books in their own language. Books survive as long as there are people to print them and people to read them.

Elon Musk stood in a Hollywood living room in 2008, 12 days from bankruptcy, and pitched a $109,000 car to people who thought he was joking. His own Roadster is parked outside production unit 1 and he mentions it the way other men mention a bicycle. He explains the money first. Congress approved $25 billion to build energy-efficient vehicles, then the Big Three flew to Washington and asked for it to cover payroll on gas guzzlers instead. Congress said yes. “That gets them to about February,” he says. Tesla applied to the same fund for the thing the fund was actually written for: a cheaper car. Then comes the part nobody in the room registers. Tesla pays no dividends and never will, because every penny from every $109,000 Roadster goes into the next car down the price ladder. His salary is minimum wage. He doesn’t mention that the company has days of cash left, or that an emergency round has to close by Christmas Eve or it’s over. He talks about cell phones instead how the first ones cost a fortune, how you can’t reach the cheap version without selling the expensive one first. 100 cars built, and the 100th goes out Tuesday. He says he’ll hand over the keys himself. GM filed for bankruptcy 6 months later, and the man on minimum wage didn’t. The tragic death of former MLA and former Dy Speaker of WBLA Asish Banerjee is not merely heartbreaking, it should trouble the conscience of everyone who believes that politics and journalism must have boundaries. A lifelong teacher and public servant, Asish Da devoted decades to serving people with honesty, dignity and simplicity. He was a respected figure and a source of pride for Rampurhat and entire Birbhum district. His final note raises serious and troubling questions about the sustained smear campaign he said he had endured. The BJP and sections of the MEDIA must reflect on the consequences of a politics where allegations are amplified, reputations are put on trial and individuals are condemned in the court of public opinion before the truth is established. Those who participated in this smear campaign should reflect on the human consequences of their words and actions. Political battles will come and go, but a life once lost can never be brought back. Bengal has lost one of its most respected sons of the soil. My deepest condolences to his family, students, admirers and well wishers. May God give them strength in this hour of unimaginable grief. Om Shanti.

The Pakistan team has not beaten India in over a decade, but Mahmood is confident of ending the streak, saying the team's performance on the day will determine the outcome. "I have no hesitation in accepting that the Indian team is much better than us in the rankings, but in the India-Pakistan match, rankings don't matter. The performance on that day is important. महाराष्ट्र फूड एंड ड्रग एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन (FDA) ने शाहरुख खान, अजय देवगन और टाइगर श्रॉफ को कारण बताओ नोटिस जारी किया है। FDA का आरोप है कि ‘विमल इलायची’ के विज्ञापन के जरिए राज्य में प्रतिबंधित ‘विमल पान मसाला’ का इनडायरेक्ट प्रचार किया जा रहा है। न्यूज एजेंसी PTI के मुताबिक, FDA ने 11 अगस्त को तीनों को नोटिस भेजकर विज्ञापन में उनकी भूमिका पर 15 दिन में जवाब और स्पष्टीकरण मांगा है। शाहरुख खान को बांद्रा स्थित उनके घर ‘मन्नत’, अजय देवगन को जुहू स्थित आवास और टाइगर श्रॉफ को उनकी प्रोडक्शन कंपनी ‘टाइगर श्रॉफ प्रोडक्शंस एलएलपी’ के पते पर नोटिस भेजा गया है। FDA का कहना है कि विज्ञापन में ‘विमल’ नाम, प्रोडक्ट और डायलॉग इस तरह इस्तेमाल किए गए हैं कि इससे ‘विमल’ ब्रांड का प्रचार होता दिखता है। चूंकि ‘विमल’ ब्रांड पान मसाला से भी जुड़ा है, इसलिए FDA को शक है कि विज्ञापन के जरिए प्रतिबंधित पान मसाले का इनडायरेक्ट प्रचार किया जा रहा है। #ShahrukhKhan #AjayDevgn #TigerShroff #Elaichi #FDA #Maharashtra | #ZeeNews

Really interesting research from Anthropic on using multi-agent systems for vulnerability research: anthropic.com/research/multi… Their collaborating agents found 266 vulnerabilities vs 21 for independent agents. But the part I found most interesting is that only 12 findings overlapped. Feels like another sign that the future of AI auditing probably isn’t just running one really strong model over a codebase. Different agents, different prompts, and different ways of exploring the code seem to find very different things. I think the best systems will eventually look much more like an actual audit team: multiple agents exploring independently, sharing leads, specializing in certain areas, and then having other agents try to disprove the findings. I've also been experimenting a lot with multi-agent models, assigning different roles and incentives, which has led to huge improvements. The crazy part is, @muellerberndt did this already a year ago with his AI auditing system Hound.

DETUVIERON A UNA ARGENTINA EN UN AEROPUERTO DE JAPÓN POR INTENTAR INGRESAR UN KILO DE COCAÍNA OCULTO EN SU CUERPO Una mujer argentina de 30 años fue arrestada en el aeropuerto de Haneda, Tokio, cuando intentaba ingresar alrededor de un kilo de cocaína oculto en su cuerpo. En principio, había sido demorada por su actitud sospechosa y, finalmente, descubrieron que había ingerido más de 100 cápsulas. La acusada fue identificada como Rosa Micaela Quipildor, luego de que ser detenida por la Policía Metropolitana de Tokio y la Suboficina de Aduanas de Haneda. Según confirmaron fuentes oficiales, la sospechosa había llegado a Japón el 10 de agosto en un vuelo procedente de Londres. Tras haber frustrado la maniobra, la policía sospecha que una organización sudamericana dedicada al tráfico de drogas estaría detrás de la operación. De hecho, la misma acusada reveló en su declaración que había conocido a una mujer en un festival en Argentina, que le propuso transportar la droga como forma de obtener dinero. “Recibí y consumí cocaína en Brasil. Se suponía que recibiría 7.000 dólares a cambio de la droga”, relató la acusada ante las autoridades japonesas sobre el presunto origen de los estupefacientes. Asimismo, indicó que esa mujer la había puesto en contacto con un hombre, quien habría sido el encargado de darle las instrucciones para el viaje y la forma en la que debía entregar las cápsulas. Now that I’ve had a little time to reflect on DEF CON 34, I think what stays with me most isn’t actually standing on the stage. It’s the people. Of course, seeing a full house at Recon Village while talking about something I care deeply about - OSINT, critical thinking, and the cognitive consequences of relying too heavily on AI - was incredibly special. But walking around DEF CON afterwards and having people stop me just to say hello, tell me they enjoyed the talk, challenge an idea, or continue the conversation… That genuinely meant a lot to me. I got to reconnect with old friends and somehow leave Vegas with a whole bunch of new ones. And I got to spend several days surrounded by hackers, researchers, investigators, builders, curious minds and people who simply look at the world differently. That’s probably what I’ll remember most. I came to DEF CON to share some of my thoughts. I’m leaving having had my own thinking challenged and expanded in return. And perhaps that’s exactly what a gathering like DEF CON should do. So thank you DEF CON and Recon Village for having me. Thank you to everyone who came to the talk. And especially thank you to everyone who stopped me somewhere along the way just to talk, laugh, share an idea, grab a drink or say hello. I’m humbled, grateful, slightly exhausted, and leaving with far more ideas than I arrived with. DEF CON, you’ve been an absolute blast. I’ll be back. P.S. I will re-record my talk I gave at DEFCON and post this on my Github/Youtube. Please have a little patience with that. It will be online soon. #defcon34 #reconvillage #osint #ai @defcon @ReconVillage

Another Wildberries warehouse in Russia has reportedly been struck by Ukrainian drones, this time at the company's facility in Koledino, Moscow Oblast, in an attack that occurred within the past several hours. The strike comes as Ukraine has conducted a sustained campaign against Wildberries' logistics network. Reuters previously assessed that more than 20% of the company's nationwide warehouse capacity, approximately 1.18 million square meters, had been damaged or destroyed in attacks since mid-July. Wildberries is Russia's largest online retailer, and the repeated attacks have disrupted inventory, warehouse operations and deliveries across its nationwide distribution network. The company has reportedly begun taking measures to move goods and adjust its logistics operations in response to the damage. Video

श्रद्धेय अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी जी की पुण्यतिथि पर उन्हें कोटि-कोटि नमन एवं विनम्र श्रद्धांजलि। अटल जी ने अपने विचारों और कार्यों से भारतीय लोकतंत्र को समृद्ध किया। उन्होंने आजीवन ‘राष्ट्र प्रथम, सदैव प्रथम’ की भावना के साथ कार्य किया। उनके लिए राजनीति का मूल उद्देश्य राष्ट्रहित और जनसेवा था। अटल जी के नेतृत्व में भारत ने सामरिक शक्ति, आर्थिक विकास और आधारभूत संरचना के क्षेत्र में नई ऊंचाइयों को प्राप्त किया। उन्होंने देश को मजबूत और आत्मविश्वासी बनाने तथा विकास की नई दिशा देने में अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई। उनका व्यक्तित्व, उनके आदर्श और राष्ट्रसेवा का उनका संकल्प सदैव हम सभी को प्रेरणा देता रहेगा। Video

همزمان با پنجمین سالگرد بازگشت طالبان به قدرت در افغانستان، شماری از زنان، فعالان و حامیان حقوق زن، شنبه (۱۵ اگست)، در برابر مقر سازمان ملل متحد در ژنیو، سویس، زیر نام "همبستگی با زنان و دختران افغانستان" گردهم آمدند و خواستار توجه بیشتر جامعۀ جهانی به وضعیت زنان و دختران افغان شدند. گزارش کامل این گردهمایی را یکشنبه( ۱۶ اگست)، از صدای امریکا دنبال کنید. More than 1,300 Strava users have publicly logged workouts from U.S. military sites across the U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) area, according to an investigation by Sky News cited by Task & Purpose. The exposure is particularly concerning because many of these installations have subsequently been targeted by Iran. At Muwaffaq Al Salti Air Base in Jordan, for example, personnel regularly posted runs around the installation. Activity resumed in April and later became concentrated around barracks; the housing area was struck in July, killing three U.S. soldiers. The issue isn't new. In 2018, Strava's public heat maps exposed previously undisclosed military locations and details about base layouts. The Pentagon subsequently prohibited personnel from using geolocation features on personal or government devices. CENTCOM has since issued additional OPSEC guidance, including restrictions implemented when Operation Epic Fury began. Yet publicly available Strava data shows personnel are still exposing their locations. This is particularly notable given Adm. Brad Cooper's warning last month that Iran was using troops' photos, videos and other cellphone-generated information to assess strike effectiveness and help target U.S. personnel. Below are screenshots taken from the Strava app today showing activity at Muwaffaq Al Salti Air Base, Jordan and Prince Sultan Air Base, Saudi Arabia. The blue lines are tracks uploaded to the app by users with the darker color representing higher usage of route.

The future USS John F. Kennedy (CVN-79) has successfully completed Navy acceptance trials, marking a major milestone toward delivery of the second Gerald R. Ford-class aircraft carrier to the fleet, as announced by the U.S. Navy's Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE). Acceptance trials are the Navy's formal evaluation of the completed ship to determine whether it meets its required performance and capabilities. With the trials complete, Kennedy moves toward delivery to the Navy in March 2027, followed by additional post-delivery work, crew training and certification before entering operational service. Kennedy is the second ship of the Ford class, incorporating systems including EMALS electromagnetic catapults, Advanced Arresting Gear and Advanced Weapons Elevators.

KICILLOF TEJE LAZOS CON SECTORES DEL PERONISMO FEDERAL Y RETRASA LA NEGOCIACIÓN CON MÁXIMO KIRCHNER Y MASSA | Por Facundo Cottet Tras la reunión con el resto de los sectores del peronismo, el gobernador bonaerense, Axel Kicillof, sigue con una etapa de construcción de carácter nacional y con vistas a las elecciones del año que viene. El mandatario de Buenos Aires quiere llegar a la instancia de negociación de las Primarias con la mayor estructura posible para sentarse con el resto de los sectores. Es por eso que declina la posibilidad de sellar un acuerdo político electoral en este momento. “Tenemos tiempo para definir, ya llegará el momento de negociar”, dicen en su entorno. El gobernador cree que puede acumular poder y que este año no es de candidatura, aunque sus movimientos se parezcan bastante a una. En La Plata reconocen que hoy hay solamente dos candidatos para las elecciones del año que viene: Javier Milei y Axel Kicillof. Con este cuadro de situación es que, como viene contando Infobae, ordenó acelerar el armado federal. En eso están los dirigentes que los rodean. La semana que viene habrá fuertes señales en este sentido. El gobernador bonaerense volverá a las recorridas por fuera del territorio. El miércoles estará en Chaco, una de las provincias que el peronismo perdió en las elecciones del 2023 cuando Javier Milei se impuso en la presidencia. Allí gobierna el radical Leandro Zdero. A diferencia de lo que sucedió cuando Kicillof fue a Corrientes, donde tampoco gobierna el peronismo, esta vez no habrá encuentro entre gobernadores. Durante su paso por la tierra correntina, el mandatario bonaerense se reunió con su par, Juan Pablo Valdés, con quien firmó algunos convenios de gestión. En Chaco, Kicillof participará del acto de normalización de la CGT local. Será la reasunción del binomio conformado por Adrián Bellomi (ATSA - Sanidad) e Isaías Alegre (Camioneros). Tras ello, tendrá un almuerzo cerrado de carácter político, con dirigentes. Será en Colonia Benítez. La gira culminará con la presentación de su libro “De Smith a Keynes. Siete lecciones de historia del pensamiento económico”. A Kicillof lo recibirá el ex gobernador chaqueño y actual senador nacional por esa provincia, Jorge Capitanich, que fue con quien se articuló la agenda. Además, detrás de la recorrida por la provincia del Nordeste están el titular del gremio de Sanidad y secretario del Interior de la CGT, Héctor Daer y quien quedó a cargo de la construcción nacional del espacio del gobernador: el ministro de Desarrollo de la Comunidad de PBA, Andrés “Cuervo” Larroque. Just reupping this much needed perspective on the hardships and human cost of increasing optempo and war. If journalists want to be “fair and balanced” (instead of running to DC “experts” to talk about *gestures vaguely* all of this), they would reach out to @SharrellAnne2. SharrellAnne (@SharrellAnne2) Maybe this is one of those moments where my GWOT-era perspective makes me less sympathetic than I’m supposed to be, but reading “They’re taking me away from my family longer than expected” triggers something in me that I’m not sure I can fully explain. I’m from an era where a 9-month deployment became 12, then 15, and sometimes 18. I knew soldiers who spent 18 months in the desert, living in conditions that included literally burning their own shit. They had families who desperately wanted them home too. They missed the births of their children. They missed grandparents dying. They missed birthdays, anniversaries, holidays and entire chunks of their children growing up. Communication from home wasn’t instantaneous. There was no FaceTime from the other side of the world whenever you wanted it. Sometimes news from home took days or weeks to reach them. And sometimes when that news finally arrived, it was a Dear John letter. Alan did multiple deployments between the Marine Corps and Army. Trust me, he complained. 😂 Complaining about deployment is practically a military tradition. The food sucks. Leadership sucks. You miss home. You’re tired. You were supposed to be home by now. I get all of that. What I don’t understand is treating an extension like an injustice. You’re not there on vacation. You’re there to execute a mission, and sometimes the mission doesn’t give a damn what date was originally circled on the calendar. But there’s another part of this that absolutely blows my mind: spouses sharing these private messages with the media while their sailors are actively deployed on combat operations. I cannot imagine handing private messages between Alan and me to a reporter while he was downrange. The hell that would have descended on both of us, and especially on him, is difficult to describe. If Alan needed to tell me deployment sucked, he could tell me deployment sucked. My job at home was to be the safe place where he could say it, not turn around and send screenshots of that conversation to the media. There are legitimate reasons to hold military leadership accountable. But no fresh milk, shitty produce, missing your family and being deployed longer than expected do not convince me our service members are being pushed beyond the limits of human endurance. Maybe I’m just getting old. Maybe deployment culture really has changed this much and I’m the one who hasn’t caught up. But I read these messages and don’t think, How could the Navy do this to them? I think, when did we get this damn soft? — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/SharrellAnne2/status/2088420427378909643#m

Today, I signed a decree on measures at the state level to protect Ukraine’s national shrines. A law on our Ukrainian national shrines will be prepared for Ukraine’s Independence Day – we discussed this with Chairman of the Verkhovna Rada Ruslan Stefanchuk – and I ask MPs to support it. It should clearly define what constitutes our national shrines and what steps are needed to protect our shrines throughout the entire territory of Ukraine. And this status of national shrines, enshrined in law, should give more opportunities to the teams of our shrines – to everyone working to protect Ukrainian heritage – strengthening them in their working conditions, financial capacity, and political and legal tools for protecting our shrines, our museum collections, and our heritage. From the address marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra. 3/3 Video

Today, representatives of UNESCO and our partners around the world are here with us, as are representatives of countries working with Ukraine. Thank you all for standing with us and honoring our statehood and our spirit. But much more must be done to stop this war, to protect this beauty, and to ensure that the history of our Ukrainian shrines continues. More of our Ukrainian shrines deserve to become part of the UNESCO World Heritage List and receive the corresponding attention, protection, and opportunities for restoration. We need more political and sanctions-related work to protect the shrines of our people throughout the entire territory of Ukraine – including Crimea and other parts of our occupied land. From the address marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra. 2/3 Video

Today, we mark the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra – almost a millennium. Longer than the history of individual people, families, or generations. And yet still less than everything that unites us – unites us into a community, a nation, a state. Unites us as Ukraine. We must preserve every one of our national shrines like this. And all the more so now, when the challenges of the passage of time have been compounded by the challenges of Russia’s utterly godless and asinine war against Ukraine and against all the places of our culture, our history, our memory – against all places that embody humanity. You have to be utterly despicable and utterly witless to strike the Lavra, but Russia did it. From the address marking the 975th anniversary of the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra. 1/3 Video

It may be hard to comprehend what 975 years means. Not just the changing of seasons, but generations of people, societies, technologies and even empires coming and going. Yet some places have stood through it all – and now the Kyiv-Pechersk Lavra marks its 975th anniversary. For almost a millennium, the Lavra has been a place where culture and knowledge have flourished. It brought together scholars, writers, artists, craftsmen and physicians, leaving a lasting mark on Ukraine’s and Europe’s spiritual and cultural life. The Lavra’s history is a powerful reminder of why it must be protected – as a part of Ukraine’s national memory and of the world’s shared cultural heritage.

The Indian Army–Air India Memorandum of Cooperation has now translated intent into opportunity, with 58 candidates selected pan-India for employment with Air India including two girls selected internationally for Air Emirates. The first batch of 16 candidates, including #VeerNaris and their wards have now been trained and inducted. With interviews expanding across the country, this is more than a partnership, it is a new beginning that opens meaningful career pathways and transforms lives. ADG PI - INDIAN ARMY (@adgpi) Indian Army and M/s Air India Ltd signed a Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) in the presence of #GeneralUpendraDwivedi, #COAS, towards further strengthening welfare initiatives for the Army fraternity. Built on the three pillars of Employment, Empowerment and Environment, the partnership aims to create lifelong employment avenues for Veer Naris and their wards, support vocational training infrastructure in ASHA Schools and promote environment-friendly mobility solutions at Army Hospitals. Under the initiative, 20 vacancies for Veer Naris and 40 vacancies for their wards will be provided across seven airports.
